  2055→// Main entry point for the CLI
  2056→func main() {
  2057→	// Parse critical flags early by manually checking os.Args
  2058→	// This is necessary because cobra's ParseFlags doesn't work correctly before subcommands are added
  2059→	for _, arg := range os.Args[1:] {
  2060→		switch arg {
  2061→		case "--no-usage-analytics":
  2062→			noAnalytics = true
  2063→		case "--console":
  2064→			console = true
  2065→		case "--log":
  2066→			logFile = true
  2067→		case "--debug":
  2068→			debug = true
  2069→		case "--silent":
  2070→			silent = true
  2071→		case "--no-version-check":
  2072→			noVersionCheck = true
  2073→		}
  2074→		// Handle --output-dir=value format
  2075→		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--output-dir=") {
  2076→			outputDir = strings.TrimPrefix(arg, "--output-dir=")
  2077→		}
  2078→	}
  2079→
  2080→	// Set up logging early before creating commands (which access the registry)
  2081→	if console || logFile {
  2082→		var logPath string
  2083→		if logFile {
  2084→			config, _ := utils.SetupOutputConfig(outputDir)
  2085→			logPath = config.GetLogPath()
  2086→		}
  2087→		_ = log.SetupLogger(console, logFile, debug, logPath)
  2088→	} else {
  2089→		// Set up discard logger to prevent default slog output
  2090→		_ = log.SetupLogger(false, false, false, "")
  2091→	}
  2092→
  2093→	// NOW create the commands - after logging is configured
  2094→	rootCmd = createRootCommand()
  2095→	runCmd = createRunCommand()
  2096→	watchCmd = createWatchCommand()
  2097→	syncCmd = createSyncCommand()
  2098→	checkCmd = createCheckCommand()
  2099→
  2100→	// Set version for the automatic version flag
  2101→	rootCmd.Version = version
  2102→
  2103→	// Override the default version template to match our version command output
  2104→	rootCmd.SetVersionTemplate("{{.Version}} (SpecStory)")
  2105→
  2106→	// Set our custom help command (for "specstory help")
  2107→	rootCmd.SetHelpCommand(helpCmd)
  2108→
  2109→	// Add the subcommands
  2110→	rootCmd.AddCommand(runCmd)
  2111→	rootCmd.AddCommand(watchCmd)
  2112→	rootCmd.AddCommand(syncCmd)
  2113→	rootCmd.AddCommand(versionCmd)
  2114→	rootCmd.AddCommand(checkCmd)
  2115→	rootCmd.AddCommand(loginCmd)
  2116→	rootCmd.AddCommand(logoutCmd)
  2117→
  2118→	// Global flags available on all commands
  2119→	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().BoolVar(&console, "console", false, "enable error/warn/info output to stdout")
  2120→	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().BoolVar(&logFile, "log", false, "write error/warn/info output to ./.specstory/debug/debug.log")
  2121→	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().BoolVar(&debug, "debug", false, "enable debug-level output (requires --console or --log)")
  2122→	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().BoolVar(&noAnalytics, "no-usage-analytics", false, "disable usage analytics")
  2123→	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().BoolVar(&silent, "silent", false, "suppress all non-error output")
  2124→	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().BoolVar(&noVersionCheck, "no-version-check", false, "skip checking for newer versions")
  2125→	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().StringVar(&cloudToken, "cloud-token", "", "use a SpecStory Cloud refresh token for this session (bypasses login)")
  2126→	_ = rootCmd.PersistentFlags().MarkHidden("cloud-token") // Hidden flag
  2127→
  2128→	// Command-specific flags
  2129→	syncCmd.Flags().StringSliceP("session", "s", []string{}, "optional session IDs to sync (can be specified multiple times, provider-specific format)")
  2130→	syncCmd.Flags().StringVar(&outputDir, "output-dir", "", "custom output directory for markdown and debug files (default: ./.specstory/history)")
  2131→	syncCmd.Flags().BoolVar(&noCloudSync, "no-cloud-sync", false, "disable cloud sync functionality")
  2132→	syncCmd.Flags().BoolVar(&onlyCloudSync, "only-cloud-sync", false, "skip local markdown file saves, only upload to cloud (requires authentication)")
  2133→	syncCmd.Flags().StringVar(&cloudURL, "cloud-url", "", "override the default cloud API base URL")
  2134→	_ = syncCmd.Flags().MarkHidden("cloud-url") // Hidden flag
  2135→	syncCmd.Flags().Bool("debug-raw", false, "debug mode to output pretty-printed raw data files")
  2136→	_ = syncCmd.Flags().MarkHidden("debug-raw") // Hidden flag
  2137→	syncCmd.Flags().BoolP("local-time-zone", "", false, "use local timezone for file name and content timestamps (when not present: UTC)")
  2138→
  2139→	runCmd.Flags().StringP("command", "c", "", "custom agent execution command for the provider")
  2140→	runCmd.Flags().String("resume", "", "resume a specific session by ID")
  2141→	runCmd.Flags().StringVar(&outputDir, "output-dir", "", "custom output directory for markdown and debug files (default: ./.specstory/history)")
  2142→	runCmd.Flags().BoolVar(&noCloudSync, "no-cloud-sync", false, "disable cloud sync functionality")
  2143→	runCmd.Flags().BoolVar(&onlyCloudSync, "only-cloud-sync", false, "skip local markdown file saves, only upload to cloud (requires authentication)")
  2144→	runCmd.Flags().StringVar(&cloudURL, "cloud-url", "", "override the default cloud API base URL")
  2145→	_ = runCmd.Flags().MarkHidden("cloud-url") // Hidden flag
  2146→	runCmd.Flags().Bool("debug-raw", false, "debug mode to output pretty-printed raw data files")
  2147→	_ = runCmd.Flags().MarkHidden("debug-raw") // Hidden flag
  2148→	runCmd.Flags().BoolP("local-time-zone", "", false, "use local timezone for file name and content timestamps (when not present: UTC)")
  2149→
  2150→	watchCmd.Flags().StringVar(&outputDir, "output-dir", "", "custom output directory for markdown and debug files (default: ./.specstory/history)")
  2151→	watchCmd.Flags().BoolVar(&noCloudSync, "no-cloud-sync", false, "disable cloud sync functionality")
  2152→	watchCmd.Flags().BoolVar(&onlyCloudSync, "only-cloud-sync", false, "skip local markdown file saves, only upload to cloud (requires authentication)")
  2153→	watchCmd.Flags().StringVar(&cloudURL, "cloud-url", "", "override the default cloud API base URL")
  2154→	_ = watchCmd.Flags().MarkHidden("cloud-url") // Hidden flag
  2155→	watchCmd.Flags().Bool("debug-raw", false, "debug mode to output pretty-printed raw data files")
  2156→	_ = watchCmd.Flags().MarkHidden("debug-raw") // Hidden flag

  2158→
  2159→	checkCmd.Flags().StringP("command", "c", "", "custom agent execution command for the provider")
  2160→

  2162→	logoutCmd.Flags().StringVar(&cloudURL, "cloud-url", "", "override the default cloud API base URL")
  2163→	_ = logoutCmd.Flags().MarkHidden("cloud-url") // Hidden flag

  2166→	_ = loginCmd.Flags().MarkHidden("cloud-url") // Hidden flag

  2168→	// Initialize analytics with the full CLI command (unless disabled)
  2169→	slog.Debug("Analytics initialization check", "noAnalytics", noAnalytics, "flag_should_disable", noAnalytics)
  2170→	if !noAnalytics {
  2171→		slog.Debug("Initializing analytics")
  2172→		fullCommand := strings.Join(os.Args, " ")
  2173→		if err := analytics.Init(fullCommand, version); err != nil {
  2174→			// Log error but don't fail - analytics should not break the app
  2175→			slog.Warn("Failed to initialize analytics", "error", err)
  2176→		}
  2177→		defer func() { _ = analytics.Close() }() // Analytics errors shouldn't break the app
  2178→	} else {
  2179→		slog.Debug("Analytics disabled by --no-usage-analytics flag")
  2180→	}
  2181→
  2182→	// Check for updates (blocking)
  2183→	utils.CheckForUpdates(version, noVersionCheck, silent)
  2184→
  2185→	// Ensure proper cleanup and logging on exit
  2186→	defer func() {
  2187→		if r := recover(); r != nil {
  2188→			slog.Error("=== SpecStory PANIC ===", "panic", r)
  2189→			// Still try to wait for cloud sync even on panic
  2190→			_ = cloud.Shutdown(cloud.CloudSyncTimeout)
  2191→			log.CloseLogger()
  2192→			panic(r) // Re-panic after logging
  2193→		}
  2194→		// Wait for cloud sync operations to complete before exiting
  2195→		cloudStats := cloud.Shutdown(cloud.CloudSyncTimeout)
  2196→
  2197→		// Track cloud sync analytics if we have stats
  2198→		if cloudStats != nil {
  2199→			// Calculate total attempted (all sessions that started sync)
  2200→			totalCloudSessions := cloudStats.SessionsAttempted
  2201→
  2202→			// Track cloud sync completion event
  2203→			if cloudStats.SessionsUpdated > 0 || cloudStats.SessionsCreated > 0 || cloudStats.SessionsErrored > 0 || cloudStats.SessionsTimedOut > 0 {
  2204→				analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCloudSyncComplete, analytics.Properties{
  2205→					"sessions_created":   cloudStats.SessionsCreated,
  2206→					"sessions_updated":   cloudStats.SessionsUpdated,
  2207→					"sessions_skipped":   cloudStats.SessionsSkipped,
  2208→					"sessions_errored":   cloudStats.SessionsErrored,
  2209→					"sessions_timed_out": cloudStats.SessionsTimedOut,
  2210→					"total":              totalCloudSessions,
  2211→				})
  2212→			}
  2213→
  2214→			// Display cloud sync stats if not in silent mode
  2215→			if !silent && totalCloudSessions > 0 {
  2216→				fmt.Println() // Visual separation from provider sync output
  2217→
  2218→				// Determine if sync was complete or incomplete based on errors/timeouts
  2219→				if cloudStats.SessionsErrored > 0 || cloudStats.SessionsTimedOut > 0 {
  2220→					fmt.Printf("❌ Cloud sync incomplete! 📊 %s%d%s %s processed\n",
  2221→						log.ColorBoldCyan, totalCloudSessions, log.ColorReset, pluralSession(int(totalCloudSessions)))
  2222→				} else {
  2223→					fmt.Printf("☁️  Cloud sync complete! 📊 %s%d%s %s processed\n",
  2224→						log.ColorBoldCyan, totalCloudSessions, log.ColorReset, pluralSession(int(totalCloudSessions)))
  2225→				}
  2226→				fmt.Println()
  2227→

### 2. **Progress Dots Location**

**File**: `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/main.go`

      _ = os.Stdout.Sync()

  ```

After processing each session, a dot (`.`) is printed to show progress. The `os.Stdout.Sync()` ensures the dot appears immediately (unbuffered output).

### 3. **"Syncing markdown files..." Message Location**

**File**: `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/main.go`

- **Lines 1171-1173** (syncProvider function):

  }

This message appears after retrieving all sessions from the provider, on a new line after the "Parsing..." message.

### 4. **Session Count Knowledge - DO WE KNOW IT UPFRONT?**

**Answer: Yes, we know the total session count before starting the sync.**

**File**: `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/main.go`

- **Lines 1156-1162** (syncProvider function):

  if err != nil {

The provider's `GetAgentChatSessions()` method (defined in `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi/provider.go` at **line 54**) returns **all sessions at once** before processing begins. This means:

### 5. **Overall Flow of `specstory sync` Command**

**File**: `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/main.go`

The flow is:

1. **Lines 1409-1420** (syncAllProviders): For each provider with activity:

```text
Now I have a complete picture of the codebase. Let me summarize my findings and propose a design.

## Analysis Summary

### Current Flow

1. **main.go (lines 1409-1413 and 1504-1509)**: Prints "Parsing {Provider} sessions" with no newline, then calls `syncProvider()`
2. **syncProvider() (main.go:1157)**: Calls `provider.GetAgentChatSessions(cwd, debugRaw)` - THIS IS THE SLOW PART
3. After GetAgentChatSessions returns, prints newline and "Syncing markdown files" (main.go:1172)
4. Loop processes sessions with progress dots (main.go:1284-1288)

### How Session Discovery Works

**Claude Code Provider** (`pkg/providers/claudecode/`):
- `GetAgentChatSessions()` calls `parser.ParseProjectSessions()` (jsonl_parser.go)
- Uses `filepath.Walk()` to find all `.jsonl` files in the project directory
- For each file: parses JSON, builds DAGs, deduplicates, flattens
- Already has `NoteProgress()` function that prints dots during parsing (line 117, 139, 144, 164)
- Problem: The caller (`syncProvider`) does not pass down `silent` flag

**Codex CLI Provider** (`pkg/providers/codexcli/`):
- `GetAgentChatSessions()` calls `findCodexSessions()` which traverses `~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/`
- For each session file found, it calls `processSessionToAgentChat()` which reads and parses the full file
- No progress feedback at all

**Droid CLI Provider** (`pkg/providers/droidcli/`):
- `GetAgentChatSessions()` calls `listSessionFiles()` which walks `~/.factory/sessions/`
- For each file, calls `parseFactorySession()` which reads and parses the full file
- No progress feedback at all

### Key Insight: Can We Know Total Files First?

YES! All providers can enumerate files before parsing:
- **Claude Code**: `filepath.Walk()` can count `.jsonl` files first
- **Codex CLI**: The directory traversal already collects all matching sessions
- **Droid CLI**: `listSessionFiles()` already returns all files before parsing

## Design Proposal

### Option 1: Progress Callback in Provider Interface (Recommended)

Add a progress callback parameter to `GetAgentChatSessions`:

```go
// ProgressCallback is called during session parsing to report progress
type ProgressCallback func(current, total int, sessionID string)

// Updated signature
GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress ProgressCallback) ([]AgentChatSession, error)
```

**Pros:**
- Clean, explicit API
- Enables both dot progress and "n/m" count display
- Providers control when to emit progress
- Consistent across all providers

**Cons:**
- Breaking change to Provider interface (requires updating all providers)

### Option 2: Two-Phase Discovery (Alternative)

Add a new method to enumerate sessions without parsing:

```go
// Returns list of session IDs/paths that will be parsed
DiscoverSessions(projectPath string) ([]string, error)

// Parse a single session (already exists as GetAgentChatSession)
```

**Pros:**
- Non-breaking (adds new method)
- Allows counting first, then showing "1/36, 2/36..." progress

**Cons:**
- More complex (two calls needed)
- Some providers may need to re-traverse directory structure
- Adds complexity to caller logic

### Option 3: Minimal Change - Silent Flag Pass-Through

Keep existing interface but ensure `silent` flag is passed through properly. Claude Code already has `NoteProgress()` - just needs the flag passed down.

**Pros:**
- Minimal code change
- Quick to implement

**Cons:**
- Only adds dot progress, not "n/m" counts
- Doesn't address Codex CLI and Droid CLI providers
- Less informative to users

## Recommended Approach: Option 1 with Backward Compatibility

    23→// GenerateAgentSession creates a SessionData from a Claude Code Session
    24→// The session should already be parsed from JSONL with records in chronological order
    25→func GenerateAgentSession(session Session, workspaceRoot string) (*SessionData, error) {
    26→	slog.Info("GenerateAgentSession: Starting", "sessionID", session.SessionUuid, "recordCount", len(session.Records))
    27→
    28→	if len(session.Records) == 0 {
    29→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("session has no records")
    30→	}
    31→
    32→	// Extract metadata from records
    33→	createdAt := extractCreatedAtFromRecords(session.Records)
    34→	if workspaceRoot == "" {
    35→		workspaceRoot = extractWorkspaceRootFromRecords(session.Records)
    36→	}
    37→
    38→	// Group records into exchanges
    39→	exchanges, err := buildExchangesFromRecords(session.Records, workspaceRoot)
    40→	if err != nil {
    41→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build exchanges: %w", err)
    42→	}
    43→
    44→	// Assign exchangeId to each exchange (format: sessionId:index)
    45→	for i := range exchanges {
    46→		exchanges[i].ExchangeID = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.SessionUuid, i)
    47→	}
    48→
    49→	slog.Info("GenerateAgentSession: Built exchanges", "count", len(exchanges))
    50→
    51→	// Populate FormattedMarkdown for all tools
    52→	for i := range exchanges {
    53→		for j := range exchanges[i].Messages {
    54→			msg := &exchanges[i].Messages[j]
    55→			if msg.Tool != nil {
    56→				formattedMd := formatToolAsMarkdown(msg.Tool, workspaceRoot)
    57→				msg.Tool.FormattedMarkdown = &formattedMd
    58→			}
    59→		}
    60→	}
    61→
    62→	sessionData := &SessionData{
    63→		SchemaVersion: "1.0",
    64→		Provider: ProviderInfo{
    65→			ID:      "claude-code",
    66→			Name:    "Claude Code",
    67→			Version: "unknown",
    68→		},
    69→		SessionID:     session.SessionUuid,
    70→		CreatedAt:     createdAt,
    71→		WorkspaceRoot: workspaceRoot,
    72→		Exchanges:     exchanges,
    73→	}
    74→
    75→	return sessionData, nil
    76→}

    78→// extractCreatedAtFromRecords extracts the earliest timestamp from JSONL records
    79→func extractCreatedAtFromRecords(records []JSONLRecord) string {
    80→	if len(records) == 0 {
    81→		return time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339)
    82→	}
    83→
    84→	// Get timestamp from first record
    85→	if timestamp, ok := records[0].Data["timestamp"].(string); ok && timestamp != "" {
    86→		return timestamp
    87→	}
    88→
    89→	return time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339)
    90→}
    91→
    92→// extractWorkspaceRootFromRecords extracts the workspace root from JSONL records
    93→func extractWorkspaceRootFromRecords(records []JSONLRecord) string {
    94→	for _, record := range records {
    95→		if cwd, ok := record.Data["cwd"].(string); ok && cwd != "" {
    96→			return cwd
    97→		}
    98→	}
    99→	return ""
   100→}
   101→
   102→// buildExchangesFromRecords groups JSONL records into exchanges
   103→// An exchange is a user prompt followed by agent responses and tool results
   104→// Records are assumed to be in chronological order from JSONL parsing
   105→func buildExchangesFromRecords(records []JSONLRecord, workspaceRoot string) ([]Exchange, error) {
   106→	var exchanges []Exchange
   107→	var currentExchange *Exchange
   108→	var exchangeStartTime string
   109→
   110→	for _, record := range records {
   111→		recordType, _ := record.Data["type"].(string)
   112→		timestamp, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   113→
   114→		// Check if this is a sidechain message (subagent conversation)
   115→		// Note: warmup messages are filtered earlier by filterWarmupMessages
   116→		isSidechain, _ := record.Data["isSidechain"].(bool)
   117→
   118→		switch recordType {
   119→		case "user":
   120→			// Check if this is a tool result or a new user message
   121→			message, _ := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   122→			messageContent, _ := message["content"].([]interface{})
   123→
   124→			isToolResult := false
   125→			if len(messageContent) > 0 {
   126→				if firstContent, ok := messageContent[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   127→					if contentType, ok := firstContent["type"].(string); ok && contentType == "tool_result" {
   128→						isToolResult = true
   129→					}
   130→				}
   131→			}
   132→
   133→			if isToolResult {
   134→				// This is a tool result - merge it into the previous tool use
   135→				if currentExchange != nil {
   136→					mergeToolResultIntoExchange(currentExchange, messageContent)
   137→					currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
   138→				}
   139→			} else {
   140→				// This is a new user prompt
   141→
   142→				// Sidechain messages append to current exchange (parent agent talking to subagent)
   143→				// rather than starting a new exchange like regular user prompts do
   144→				if isSidechain {
   145→					if currentExchange == nil {
   146→						slog.Warn("Sidechain user message with no current exchange", "uuid", record.Data["uuid"])
   147→						continue
   148→					}
   149→					msg := buildUserMessage(record, isSidechain)
   150→					currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, msg)
   151→					currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
   152→					continue
   153→				}
   154→
   155→				// Non-sidechain: start a new exchange
   156→				if currentExchange != nil {
   157→					exchanges = append(exchanges, *currentExchange)
   158→				}
   159→
   160→				currentExchange = &Exchange{
   161→					StartTime: timestamp,
   162→					Messages:  []Message{buildUserMessage(record, isSidechain)},
   163→				}
   164→			}
   165→
   166→		case "assistant":
   167→			// Agent message - add to current exchange
   168→			if currentExchange == nil {
   169→				// Create exchange if we don't have one (shouldn't happen normally)
   170→				exchangeStartTime = timestamp
   171→				currentExchange = &Exchange{
   172→					StartTime: exchangeStartTime,
   173→					Messages:  []Message{},
   174→				}
   175→			}
   176→
   177→			msg := buildAgentMessage(record, workspaceRoot, isSidechain)
   178→			currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, msg)
   179→			currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
   180→		}
   181→	}
   182→
   183→	// Add the last exchange if exists
   184→	if currentExchange != nil && len(currentExchange.Messages) > 0 {
   185→		exchanges = append(exchanges, *currentExchange)
   186→	}
   187→
   188→	// Records are already in chronological order from JSONL parsing,
   189→	// so exchanges are also in order. No sorting needed.
   190→
   191→	return exchanges, nil
   192→}
   193→
   194→// mergeToolResultIntoExchange finds the tool use in the exchange and adds the result to it
   195→func mergeToolResultIntoExchange(exchange *Exchange, messageContent []interface{}) {
   196→	// Extract tool_result data from message content
   197→	if len(messageContent) == 0 {
   198→		return
   199→	}
   200→
   201→	toolResultMap, ok := messageContent[0].(map[string]interface{})
   202→	if !ok {
   203→		return
   204→	}
   205→
   206→	// Get the tool_use_id that this result corresponds to
   207→	toolUseID, ok := toolResultMap["tool_use_id"].(string)
   208→	if !ok || toolUseID == "" {
   209→		return
   210→	}
   211→
   212→	// Extract result content and error status
   213→	// Content can be either a string or an array of text objects (for Task tool results)
   214→	var content string
   215→	if contentStr, ok := toolResultMap["content"].(string); ok {
   216→		content = contentStr
   217→	} else if contentArray, ok := toolResultMap["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   218→		// Array of text objects like [{"type":"text","text":"..."}]
   219→		var parts []string
   220→		for _, item := range contentArray {
   221→			if itemMap, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   222→				if text, ok := itemMap["text"].(string); ok {
   223→					parts = append(parts, text)
   224→				}
   225→			}
   226→		}
   227→		content = strings.Join(parts, "\n")
   228→	}
   229→	isError, _ := toolResultMap["is_error"].(bool)
   230→
   231→	// Find the message with matching tool use ID and add the output
   232→	for i := range exchange.Messages {
   233→		msg := &exchange.Messages[i]
   234→		if msg.Tool != nil && msg.Tool.UseID == toolUseID {
   235→			// Add the output to this tool
   236→			msg.Tool.Output = map[string]interface{}{
   237→				"content":  content,
   238→				"is_error": isError,
   239→			}
   240→			return
   241→		}
   242→	}
   243→}
   244→
   245→// buildUserMessage creates a Message from a user JSONL record
   246→func buildUserMessage(record JSONLRecord, isSidechain bool) Message {
   247→	uuid, _ := record.Data["uuid"].(string)
   248→	timestamp, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   249→
   250→	message, _ := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   251→	var contentParts []ContentPart
   252→
   253→	// Handle different content formats
   254→	if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok {
   255→		// Simple string content
   256→		contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
   257→			Type: "text",
   258→			Text: content,
   259→		})
   260→	} else if contentArray, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   261→		// Array of content parts
   262→		for _, item := range contentArray {
   263→			if contentMap, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   264→				contentType, _ := contentMap["type"].(string)
   265→
   266→				switch contentType {
   267→				case "text":
   268→					text, _ := contentMap["text"].(string)
   269→					contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
   270→						Type: "text",
   271→						Text: text,
   272→					})
   273→				case "thinking":
   274→					thinking, _ := contentMap["thinking"].(string)
   275→					contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
   276→						Type: "thinking",
   277→						Text: thinking,
   278→					})
   279→					// tool_result is now merged into tool use, not handled here
   280→				}
   281→			}
   282→		}
   283→	}
   284→
   285→	msg := Message{
   286→		ID:        uuid,
   287→		Timestamp: timestamp,
   288→		Role:      "user",
   289→		Content:   contentParts,
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	// For sidechain messages, treat as agent (parent agent talking to subagent, not actual user input)
   293→	if isSidechain {
   294→		msg.Role = "agent"
   295→		msg.Metadata = map[string]interface{}{
   296→			"isSidechain": true,
   297→		}
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	return msg
   301→}
   302→
   303→// buildAgentMessage creates a Message from an assistant JSONL record
   304→func buildAgentMessage(record JSONLRecord, workspaceRoot string, isSidechain bool) Message {
   305→	uuid, _ := record.Data["uuid"].(string)
   306→	timestamp, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   307→
   308→	message, _ := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   309→	model, _ := message["model"].(string)
   310→
   311→	var contentParts []ContentPart
   312→	var toolInfo *ToolInfo
   313→	var pathHints []string
   314→
   315→	// Parse message content
   316→	if contentArray, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   317→		for _, item := range contentArray {
   318→			if contentMap, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   319→				contentType, _ := contentMap["type"].(string)
   320→
   321→				switch contentType {
   322→				case "text":
   323→					text, _ := contentMap["text"].(string)
   324→					if text != "" {
   325→						contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
   326→							Type: "text",
   327→							Text: text,
   328→						})
   329→					}
   330→
   331→				case "thinking":
   332→					// Preserve thinking content with its type
   333→					thinking, _ := contentMap["thinking"].(string)
   334→					if thinking != "" {
   335→						contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
   336→							Type: "thinking",
   337→							Text: thinking,
   338→						})
   339→					}
   340→
   341→				case "tool_use":
   342→					// Extract tool information
   343→					toolName, _ := contentMap["name"].(string)
   344→					toolUseID, _ := contentMap["id"].(string)
   345→					toolInput, _ := contentMap["input"].(map[string]interface{})
   346→
   347→					toolInfo = &ToolInfo{
   348→						Name:  toolName,
   349→						Type:  classifyToolType(toolName),
   350→						UseID: toolUseID,
   351→						Input: toolInput,
   352→					}
   353→
   354→					// Extract path hints from tool input
   355→					pathHints = extractPathHints(toolInput, workspaceRoot)
   356→				}
   357→			}
   358→		}
   359→	}
   360→
   361→	// Also check for tool use result in the record
   362→	if toolUseResult, ok := record.Data["toolUseResult"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   363→		if toolInfo != nil {
   364→			// Add output to existing tool info
   365→			toolInfo.Output = map[string]interface{}{
   366→				"type":     toolUseResult["type"],
   367→				"filePath": toolUseResult["filePath"],
   368→			}
   369→		}
   370→	}
   371→
   372→	msg := Message{
   373→		ID:        uuid,
   374→		Timestamp: timestamp,
   375→		Role:      "agent",
   376→		Model:     model,
   377→		Content:   contentParts,
   378→		Tool:      toolInfo,
   379→		PathHints: pathHints,
   380→	}
   381→
   382→	// Add sidechain flag to metadata if true
   383→	if isSidechain {
   384→		msg.Metadata = map[string]interface{}{
   385→			"isSidechain": true,
   386→		}
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	return msg
   390→}
   391→
   392→// classifyToolType maps tool names to standard tool types
   393→func classifyToolType(toolName string) string {
   394→	toolName = strings.ToLower(toolName)
   395→
   396→	switch toolName {
   397→	// "str_replace_editor", "write_file", "edit_file", "create_file", "append_to_file" are legacy tools, no longer in the agent
   398→	case "write", "edit", "multiedit", "str_replace_editor", "write_file", "edit_file", "create_file", "append_to_file":
   399→		return "write"
   400→	case "read", "webfetch", "read_file", "view_file", "cat": // "read_file", "view_file", "cat" are legacy tools, no longer in the agent
   401→		return "read"
   402→	case "grep", "glob", "websearch":
   403→		return "search"
   404→	case "bash", "taskoutput", "killshell":
   405→		return "shell"
   406→	case "notebookedit", "todowrite":
   407→		return "task"
   408→	case "enterplanmode", "exitplanmode", "askuserquestion", "skill", "lsp", "task":
   409→		return "generic"
   410→	default:
   411→		return "unknown"
   412→	}
   413→}
   414→
   415→// extractPathHints extracts file paths from tool input
   416→func extractPathHints(input map[string]interface{}, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   417→	var paths []string
   418→
   419→	// Common path field names
   420→	pathFields := []string{"file_path", "path", "filename", "old_path", "new_path"}
   421→	arrayFields := []string{"paths", "files", "targets"}
   422→
   423→	// Extract single path fields
   424→	for _, field := range pathFields {
   425→		if value, ok := input[field].(string); ok && value != "" {
   426→			// Normalize path if possible
   427→			normalizedPath := normalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
   428→			if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   429→				paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   430→			}
   431→		}
   432→	}
   433→
   434→	// Extract array path fields
   435→	for _, field := range arrayFields {
   436→		if arr, ok := input[field].([]interface{}); ok {
   437→			for _, item := range arr {
   438→				if path, ok := item.(string); ok && path != "" {
   439→					normalizedPath := normalizePath(path, workspaceRoot)
   440→					if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   441→						paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   442→					}
   443→				}
   444→			}
   445→		}
   446→	}
   447→
   448→	return paths
   449→}
   450→
   451→// normalizePath converts absolute paths to workspace-relative paths when possible
   452→func normalizePath(path, workspaceRoot string) string {
   453→	if workspaceRoot == "" {
   454→		return path
   455→	}
   456→
   457→	// If path is absolute and starts with workspace root, make it relative
   458→	if filepath.IsAbs(path) && strings.HasPrefix(path, workspaceRoot) {
   459→		relPath, err := filepath.Rel(workspaceRoot, path)
   460→		if err == nil {
   461→			return relPath
   462→		}
   463→	}
   464→
   465→	return path
   466→}
   467→
   468→// contains checks if a string slice contains a value
   469→func contains(slice []string, value string) bool {
   470→	for _, item := range slice {
   471→		if item == value {
   472→			return true
   473→		}
   474→	}
   475→	return false
   476→}

   478→// formatToolAsMarkdown generates formatted markdown for a tool (input + output)
   479→// Returns the inner content only (no <tool-use> tags)
   480→func formatToolAsMarkdown(tool *ToolInfo, workspaceRoot string) string {
   481→	var markdown strings.Builder
   482→
   483→	// Add _cwd to input for path normalization in formatters
   484→	if tool.Input == nil {
   485→		tool.Input = make(map[string]interface{})
   486→	}
   487→	tool.Input["_cwd"] = workspaceRoot
   488→
   489→	// Extract description if present
   490→	description := ""
   491→	if desc, ok := tool.Input["description"].(string); ok {
   492→		description = desc
   493→	}
   494→
   495→	// Format tool use based on tool name using existing formatters
   496→	var toolContent string
   497→	if formatter, ok := toolFormatters[tool.Name]; ok {
   498→		// Use tool-specific formatter
   499→		toolContent = formatter(tool.Name, tool.Input, description)
   500→	} else {
   501→		// Use default formatter
   502→		toolContent = formatDefaultTool(tool.Name, tool.Input, description)
   503→	}
   504→
   505→	// Add formatted tool content
   506→	if toolContent != "" {
   507→		markdown.WriteString(toolContent)
   508→		markdown.WriteString("\n")
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Add tool result/output if present
   512→	if tool.Output != nil {
   513→		// Check for error first
   514→		if isError, ok := tool.Output["is_error"].(bool); ok && isError {
   515→			// Blank line before code fence helps parsers inside <details> tags
   516→			markdown.WriteString("\n```text\n")
   517→			if content, ok := tool.Output["content"].(string); ok {
   518→				cleaned := stripSystemReminders(content)
   519→				cleaned = stripANSIEscapeSequences(cleaned)
   520→				markdown.WriteString(cleaned)
   521→			}
   522→			markdown.WriteString("\n```\n")
   523→		} else {
   524→			// Regular result
   525→			if content, ok := tool.Output["content"].(string); ok {
   526→				cleaned := stripSystemReminders(content)
   527→				cleaned = stripANSIEscapeSequences(cleaned)
   528→				// Only trim trailing spaces/tabs, preserve all newlines
   529→				cleaned = strings.TrimRight(cleaned, " \t")
   530→
   531→				// Special handling for AskUserQuestion - parse and format the answer nicely
   532→				if tool.Name == "AskUserQuestion" {
   533→					answer := parseAskUserQuestionAnswer(cleaned)
   534→					if answer != "" {
   535→						markdown.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n**Answer:** %s\n", answer))
   536→					} else if cleaned != "" {
   537→						// Fallback to code block if parsing fails
   538→						markdown.WriteString("\n```text\n")
   539→						markdown.WriteString(cleaned)
   540→						markdown.WriteString("\n```\n")
   541→					}
   542→				} else if strings.TrimSpace(cleaned) != TodoWriteSuccessMessage && cleaned != "" {
   543→					// Skip TodoWrite success messages
   544→					// Blank line before code fence helps parsers inside <details> tags
   545→					markdown.WriteString("\n```text\n")
   546→					markdown.WriteString(cleaned)
   547→					markdown.WriteString("\n```\n")
   548→				}
   549→			}
   550→		}
   551→	}
   552→
   553→	return markdown.String()
   554→}
   555→

   146→// extractSessionMetadata parses the session_meta record (first line)
   147→func extractSessionMetadata(records []map[string]interface{}) (sessionID, createdAt, cwd string, err error) {
   148→	if len(records) == 0 {
   149→		return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("no records to extract metadata from")
   150→	}
   151→
   152→	firstRecord := records[0]
   153→	recordType, ok := firstRecord["type"].(string)
   154→	if !ok || recordType != "session_meta" {
   155→		return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("first record is not session_meta: %v", recordType)
   156→	}
   157→
   158→	payload, ok := firstRecord["payload"].(map[string]interface{})
   159→	if !ok {
   160→		return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("session_meta payload is missing or invalid")
   161→	}
   162→
   163→	sessionID, _ = payload["id"].(string)
   164→	createdAt, _ = payload["timestamp"].(string)
   165→	cwd, _ = payload["cwd"].(string)
   166→
   167→	if sessionID == "" {
   168→		return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("session_meta is missing session ID")
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	if createdAt == "" {
   172→		// Fall back to record timestamp
   173→		createdAt, _ = firstRecord["timestamp"].(string)
   174→	}
   175→
   176→	return sessionID, createdAt, cwd, nil
   177→}

   468→// formatToolWithSummary generates custom summary and formatted markdown for a Codex tool
   469→// Returns (summary, formattedMarkdown) where summary is the custom content for <summary> tag
   470→// and formattedMarkdown is additional content to display in the tool-use block
   471→func formatToolWithSummary(tool *ToolInfo, workspaceRoot string) (string, string) {
   472→	var summary string
   473→	var formattedMd strings.Builder
   474→
   475→	// Format tool input based on whether it's a function call or custom tool
   476→	if tool.Input != nil {
   477→		// Check if this is a custom tool (has string input in "input" field)
   478→		if inputStr, ok := tool.Input["input"].(string); ok {
   479→			// Custom tool with text input (e.g., apply_patch)
   480→			formattedMd.WriteString(formatCustomToolCall(tool.Name, inputStr))
   481→		} else if tool.Name == "shell_command" {
   482→			// Shell command: check if single-line or multi-line
   483→			inputJSON, _ := json.Marshal(tool.Input)
   484→			shellSummary, shellBody := formatShellWithSummary(string(inputJSON))
   485→			if shellSummary != "" {
   486→				// Single-line command goes in summary
   487→				summary = fmt.Sprintf("Tool use: **%s** %s", tool.Name, shellSummary)
   488→			}
   489→			if shellBody != "" {
   490→				formattedMd.WriteString(shellBody)
   491→			}
   492→		} else {
   493→			// Other function calls with JSON arguments
   494→			inputJSON, _ := json.Marshal(tool.Input)
   495→			formattedMd.WriteString(formatToolCall(tool.Name, string(inputJSON)))
   496→		}
   497→	}
   498→
   499→	// Format tool output if present
   500→	if tool.Output != nil {
   501→		if outputStr, ok := tool.Output["raw"].(string); ok {
   502→			// Clean and truncate output if needed
   503→			cleaned := strings.TrimSpace(outputStr)
   504→			// Only show output if there's actual content
   505→			if cleaned != "" {
   506→				if formattedMd.Len() > 0 {
   507→					formattedMd.WriteString("\n")
   508→				}
   509→				if len(cleaned) > 5000 {
   510→					cleaned = cleaned[:5000] + "\n... (truncated)"
   511→				}
   512→				formattedMd.WriteString("```\n" + cleaned + "\n```")
   513→			}
   514→		}
   515→	}
   516→
   517→	return summary, strings.TrimSpace(formattedMd.String())
   518→}
   519→
   520→// classifyToolType maps Codex tool names to standard tool types
   521→func classifyToolType(toolName string) string {
   522→	switch toolName {
   523→	case "shell", "shell_command": // `shell` is legacy
   524→		return "shell"
   525→	case "update_plan":
   526→		return "task"
   527→	case "view_image":
   528→		return "read"
   529→	case "apply_patch":
   530→		return "write"
   531→	case "list_mcp_resources", "list_mcp_resource_templates", "read_mcp_resource":
   532→		return "generic"
   533→	default:
   534→		return "unknown"
   535→	}
   536→}
   537→
   538→// extractPathHints extracts file paths from tool inputs.
   539→// For apply_patch: parses patch format for file paths.
   540→// For other tools: checks common path fields like "path", "file", etc.
   541→func extractPathHints(toolName string, input map[string]interface{}, inputText string, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   542→	var paths []string
   543→
   544→	if toolName == "apply_patch" {
   545→		// Parse patch format to extract file paths
   546→		// Look for lines like "*** Modify File: path", "*** Create File: path", "*** Delete File: path"
   547→		if inputText != "" {
   548→			paths = extractPathsFromPatch(inputText, workspaceRoot)
   549→		} else if inputStr, ok := input["input"].(string); ok {
   550→			paths = extractPathsFromPatch(inputStr, workspaceRoot)
   551→		}
   552→	} else {
   553→		// For other tools, check common path fields
   554→		pathFields := []string{"path", "file", "filename", "file_path"}
   555→		for _, field := range pathFields {
   556→			if value, ok := input[field].(string); ok && value != "" {
   557→				normalizedPath := normalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
   558→				if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   559→					paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   560→				}
   561→			}
   562→		}
   563→	}
   564→
   565→	return paths
   566→}
   567→
   568→// extractPathsFromPatch parses apply_patch input to find file paths
   569→func extractPathsFromPatch(patchText string, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   570→	var paths []string
   571→	lines := strings.Split(patchText, "\n")
   572→
   573→	for _, line := range lines {
   574→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   575→
   576→		// Look for patch markers - both "Create File" and "Add File" are valid
   577→		markers := []string{
   578→			"*** Modify File:",
   579→			"*** Update File:",
   580→			"*** Create File:",
   581→			"*** Add File:",
   582→			"*** Delete File:",
   583→			"*** Rename File:",
   584→			"*** Remove File:",
   585→		}
   586→
   587→		for _, marker := range markers {
   588→			if strings.HasPrefix(line, marker) {
   589→				path := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, marker))
   590→				if path != "" {
   591→					normalizedPath := normalizePath(path, workspaceRoot)
   592→					if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   593→						paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   594→					}
   595→				}
   596→				break
   597→			}
   598→		}
   599→
   600→		// For rename, also check for "*** New Name:" marker
   601→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*** New Name:") {
   602→			path := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "*** New Name:"))
   603→			if path != "" {
   604→				normalizedPath := normalizePath(path, workspaceRoot)
   605→				if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
   606→					paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
   607→				}
   608→			}
   609→		}
   610→	}
   611→
   612→	return paths
   613→}
   614→
   615→// normalizePath converts absolute paths to workspace-relative paths when possible
   616→func normalizePath(path, workspaceRoot string) string {
   617→	if workspaceRoot == "" {
   618→		return path
   619→	}
   620→
   621→	// If path is absolute and starts with workspace root, make it relative
   622→	if filepath.IsAbs(path) && strings.HasPrefix(path, workspaceRoot) {
   623→		relPath, err := filepath.Rel(workspaceRoot, path)
   624→		if err == nil {
   625→			return relPath
   626→		}
   627→	}
   628→
   629→	return path
   630→}
   631→
   632→// contains checks if a string slice contains a value
   633→func contains(slice []string, value string) bool {
   634→	for _, item := range slice {
   635→		if item == value {
   636→			return true
   637→		}
   638→	}
   639→	return false
   640→}
   641→

    21→// GenerateAgentSession converts an fdSession into the shared SessionData schema.
    22→func GenerateAgentSession(session *fdSession, workspaceRoot string) (*SessionData, error) {
    23→	if session == nil {
    24→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("session is nil")
    25→	}

    27→	workspaceRoot = strings.TrimSpace(workspaceRoot)

    32→	exchanges, lastTimestamp := buildExchanges(session, workspaceRoot)

    35→	}
    36→
    37→	for idx := range exchanges {
    38→		exchanges[idx].ExchangeID = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.ID, idx)
    39→		ensureExchangeTimestamps(&exchanges[idx])
    40→	}
    41→
    42→	created := strings.TrimSpace(session.CreatedAt)

    73→func buildExchanges(session *fdSession, workspaceRoot string) ([]Exchange, string) {
    74→	var exchanges []Exchange
    75→	var current *Exchange
    76→	var lastTimestamp string
    77→	lastBlockWasUser := false
    78→
    79→	flush := func() {
    80→		if current == nil {
    81→			return
    82→		}
    83→		if len(current.Messages) > 0 {
    84→			if current.StartTime == "" {
    85→				current.StartTime = current.Messages[0].Timestamp
    86→			}
    87→			if current.EndTime == "" {
    88→				current.EndTime = current.Messages[len(current.Messages)-1].Timestamp
    89→			}
    90→			exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
    91→		}
    92→		current = nil
    93→		lastBlockWasUser = false
    94→	}
    95→
    96→	appendMessage := func(msg Message, timestamp string) {
    97→		if current == nil {
    98→			current = &Exchange{StartTime: timestamp}
    99→		}
   100→		current.Messages = append(current.Messages, msg)
   101→		if timestamp != "" {
   102→			current.EndTime = timestamp
   103→		}
   104→	}
   105→
   106→	for _, block := range session.Blocks {
   107→		ts := strings.TrimSpace(block.Timestamp)
   108→		if ts != "" {
   109→			lastTimestamp = ts
   110→		}
   111→
   112→		if isUserBlock(block) {
   113→			text := cleanUserText(block.Text)
   114→			if text == "" {
   115→				continue
   116→			}
   117→			if !lastBlockWasUser {
   118→				flush()
   119→				current = &Exchange{StartTime: ts}
   120→			}
   121→			msg := Message{
   122→				ID:        strings.TrimSpace(block.MessageID),
   123→				Timestamp: ts,
   124→				Role:      "user",
   125→				Content: []ContentPart{
   126→					{Type: "text", Text: text},
   127→				},
   128→			}
   129→			appendMessage(msg, ts)
   130→			lastBlockWasUser = true
   131→			continue
   132→		}
   133→
   134→		if current == nil {
   135→			current = &Exchange{StartTime: ts}
   136→		}
   137→		lastBlockWasUser = false
   138→
   139→		switch block.Kind {
   140→		case blockText:
   141→			if msg := buildAgentTextMessage(block); msg != nil {
   142→				appendMessage(*msg, ts)
   143→			}
   144→		case blockTool:
   145→			if msg := buildToolMessage(block, workspaceRoot); msg != nil {
   146→				appendMessage(*msg, ts)
   147→			}
   148→		case blockTodo:
   149→			if msg := buildTodoMessage(block); msg != nil {
   150→				appendMessage(*msg, ts)
   151→			}
   152→		case blockSummary:
   153→			if msg := buildSummaryMessage(block); msg != nil {
   154→				appendMessage(*msg, ts)
   155→			}
   156→		}
   157→	}
   158→
   159→	flush()
   160→	return exchanges, lastTimestamp
   161→}

   167→	if ex.EndTime == "" && len(ex.Messages) > 0 {
   168→		ex.EndTime = ex.Messages[len(ex.Messages)-1].Timestamp
   169→	}

   273→func convertToolCallToInfo(call *fdToolCall) *ToolInfo {
   274→	if call == nil {
   275→		return nil
   276→	}
   277→	name := strings.TrimSpace(call.Name)
   278→	if name == "" {
   279→		name = "tool"
   280→	}
   281→	useID := strings.TrimSpace(call.ID)
   282→	if useID == "" {
   283→		useID = fmt.Sprintf("tool-%s", strings.ReplaceAll(call.InvokedAt, ":", ""))
   284→	}
   285→	args := decodeInput(call.Input)
   286→	var output map[string]interface{}
   287→	if call.Result != nil {
   288→		content := strings.TrimSpace(call.Result.Content)
   289→		if content != "" || call.Result.IsError {
   290→			output = map[string]interface{}{
   291→				"content": content,
   292→				"isError": call.Result.IsError,
   293→			}
   294→		}
   295→	}
   296→	tool := &ToolInfo{
   297→		Name:   name,
   298→		Type:   toolType(name),
   299→		UseID:  useID,
   300→		Input:  args,
   301→		Output: output,
   302→	}
   303→	if call.RiskLevel != "" {
   304→		summary := fmt.Sprintf("Risk level: %s", call.RiskLevel)
   305→		if strings.TrimSpace(call.RiskReason) != "" {
   306→			summary = fmt.Sprintf("%s — %s", summary, strings.TrimSpace(call.RiskReason))
   307→		}
   308→		tool.Summary = &summary
   309→	}
   310→	return tool
   311→}

   313→func todoItemsToMap(items []fdTodoItem) []map[string]interface{} {
   314→	result := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(items))
   315→	for _, item := range items {
   316→		result = append(result, map[string]interface{}{
   317→			"description": strings.TrimSpace(item.Description),
   318→			"status":      strings.TrimSpace(item.Status),
   319→		})
   320→	}
   321→	return result

   323→
   324→func extractPathHints(input map[string]interface{}, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   325→	fields := []string{"path", "file_path", "filePath", "dir", "directory",
   326→		"workdir", "cwd", "target"}
   327→	var hints []string
   328→	if input == nil {
   329→		return hints
   330→	}
   331→	for _, field := range fields {
   332→		val, ok := input[field]
   333→		if !ok {
   334→			continue
   335→		}
   336→		switch v := val.(type) {
   337→		case string:
   338→			addPathHint(&hints, v, workspaceRoot)
   339→		case []interface{}:
   340→			for _, entry := range v {
   341→				if s, ok := entry.(string); ok {
   342→					addPathHint(&hints, s, workspaceRoot)
   343→				}
   344→			}
   345→		case json.Number:
   346→			addPathHint(&hints, v.String(), workspaceRoot)
   347→		}
   348→	}
   349→	return hints
   350→}
   351→
   352→func addPathHint(hints *[]string, value string, workspaceRoot string) {
   353→	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
   354→	if value == "" {
   355→		return
   356→	}
   357→	normalized := normalizeWorkspacePath(value, workspaceRoot)
   358→	for _, existing := range *hints {
   359→		if existing == normalized {
   360→			return
   361→		}
   362→	}
   363→	*hints = append(*hints, normalized)
   364→}
   365→
   366→func normalizeWorkspacePath(path string, workspaceRoot string) string {
   367→	if workspaceRoot == "" {
   368→		return path
   369→	}
   370→	if filepath.IsAbs(path) {
   371→		if rel, err := filepath.Rel(workspaceRoot, path); err == nil {
   372→			rel = filepath.Clean(rel)
   373→			if rel == "." {
   374→				return "."
   375→			}
   376→			if !strings.HasPrefix(rel, "..") {
   377→				return rel
   378→			}
   379→		}
   380→	}
   381→	return path
   382→}

    20→// Provider implements the SPI Provider interface for Claude Code

    23→// NewProvider creates a new Claude Code provider instance

    28→// filterWarmupMessages removes warmup messages (sidechain messages before first real message)
    29→func filterWarmupMessages(records []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
    30→	// Find first non-sidechain message
    31→	firstRealMessageIndex := -1
    32→	for i, record := range records {
    33→		if isSidechain, ok := record.Data["isSidechain"].(bool); !ok || !isSidechain {
    34→			firstRealMessageIndex = i
    35→			break
    36→		}
    37→	}
    38→
    39→	// No real messages found
    40→	if firstRealMessageIndex == -1 {
    41→		return []JSONLRecord{}
    42→	}
    43→
    44→	// Return records starting from first real message
    45→	return records[firstRealMessageIndex:]
    46→}
    47→
    48→// processSession filters warmup messages and converts a Session to an AgentChatSession
    49→// Returns nil if the session is warmup-only (no real messages)
    50→func processSession(session Session, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
    51→	// Write debug files first (even for warmup-only sessions)
    52→	if debugRaw {
    53→		// Write debug files and get the record-to-file mapping
    54→		_ = writeDebugRawFiles(session) // Unused but needed for side effect
    55→	}
    56→
    57→	// Filter warmup messages
    58→	filteredRecords := filterWarmupMessages(session.Records)
    59→
    60→	// Skip if no real messages remain after filtering warmup
    61→	if len(filteredRecords) == 0 {
    62→		slog.Debug("Skipping warmup-only session", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid)
    63→		return nil
    64→	}
    65→
    66→	// Create session with filtered records
    67→	filteredSession := Session{
    68→		SessionUuid: session.SessionUuid,
    69→		Records:     filteredRecords,
    70→	}
    71→
    72→	// Get timestamp from root record
    73→	rootRecord := filteredSession.Records[0]
    74→	timestamp := rootRecord.Data["timestamp"].(string)
    75→
    76→	// Get the slug
    77→	slug := FileSlugFromRootRecord(filteredSession)

    80→	sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(filteredSession, workspaceRoot)

    88→	// all records including warmup messages in the raw data for complete audit trail
    89→	var rawDataBuilder strings.Builder

   110→// buildCheckErrorMessage creates a user-facing error message tailored to the failure type.
   111→func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, claudeCmd string, isCustom bool, stderrOutput string) string {
   112→	var errorMsg strings.Builder
   113→
   114→	switch errorType {
   115→	case "not_found":
   116→		errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  🔍 Could not find Claude Code at: %s\n", claudeCmd))
   117→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   118→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n")
   119→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   120→		if isCustom {
   121→			errorMsg.WriteString("     The specified path doesn't exist. Please check:\n")
   122→			errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("     • Is Claude Code installed at %s?\n", claudeCmd))
   123→			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Did you type the path correctly?")
   124→		} else {
   125→			errorMsg.WriteString("     1. Make sure Claude Code is installed:\n")
   126→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Visit https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart\n")
   127→			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   128→			errorMsg.WriteString("     2. If it's already installed, try:\n")
   129→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Check if 'claude' is in your PATH\n")
   130→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Use -c flag to specify the full path\n")
   131→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Example: specstory check claude -c \"~/.claude/local/claude\"")
   132→		}
   133→	case "permission_denied":
   134→		errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  🔒 Permission denied when trying to run: %s\n", claudeCmd))
   135→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   136→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n")
   137→		errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("     • Check file permissions: chmod +x %s\n", claudeCmd))
   138→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running with elevated permissions if needed")
   139→	case "unexpected_output":
   140→		errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  ⚠️  Unexpected output from 'claude -v': %s\n", strings.TrimSpace(stderrOutput)))
   141→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   142→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 This might not be Claude Code. Expected output containing '(Claude Code)'.\n")
   143→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure you have Claude Code installed, not a different 'claude' command\n")
   144→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Visit https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart for installation")
   145→	default:
   146→		errorMsg.WriteString("  ⚠️  Error running 'claude -v'\n")
   147→		if stderrOutput != "" {
   148→			errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  📋 Error details: %s\n", stderrOutput))
   149→		}
   150→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   151→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Troubleshooting tips:\n")
   152→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure Claude Code is properly installed\n")
   153→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running 'claude -v' directly in your terminal\n")
   154→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Check https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart for installation help")
   155→	}
   156→
   157→	return errorMsg.String()
   158→}

   160→// Check verifies Claude Code installation and returns version info
   161→func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
   162→	// Parse the command (no resume session for version check)
   163→	claudeCmd, _ := parseClaudeCommand(customCommand, "")
   164→
   165→	// Determine if custom command was used
   166→	isCustomCommand := customCommand != ""
   167→
   168→	// Resolve the actual path of the command
   169→	resolvedPath := claudeCmd
   170→	if !filepath.IsAbs(claudeCmd) {
   171→		// Try to find the command in PATH
   172→		if path, err := exec.LookPath(claudeCmd); err == nil {
   173→			resolvedPath = path
   174→		}
   175→	}
   176→
   177→	// Run claude -v to check version (ignore custom args for version check)
   178→	cmd := exec.Command(claudeCmd, "-v")
   179→	var out bytes.Buffer
   180→	var errOut bytes.Buffer
   181→	cmd.Stdout = &out
   182→	cmd.Stderr = &errOut
   183→
   184→	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
   185→		// Track installation check failure
   186→		errorType := "unknown"
   187→
   188→		var execErr *exec.Error
   189→		var pathErr *os.PathError
   190→
   191→		// Check error types in order of specificity
   192→		switch {
   193→		case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
   194→			errorType = "not_found"
   195→		case errors.As(err, &pathErr):
   196→			if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrNotExist) {
   197→				errorType = "not_found"
   198→			} else if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission) {
   199→				errorType = "permission_denied"
   200→			}
   201→		case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
   202→			errorType = "permission_denied"
   203→		}
   204→
   205→		stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(errOut.String())
   206→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
   207→			"provider":       "claude",
   208→			"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
   209→			"command_path":   claudeCmd,
   210→			"error_type":     errorType,
   211→			"error_message":  err.Error(),
   212→		})
   213→
   214→		errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, claudeCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
   215→
   216→		return spi.CheckResult{
   217→			Success:      false,
   218→			Version:      "",
   219→			Location:     resolvedPath,
   220→			ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
   221→		}
   222→	}
   223→
   224→	// Check if output contains "Claude Code"
   225→	output := out.String()
   226→	if !strings.Contains(output, "(Claude Code)") {
   227→		// Track unexpected output error
   228→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
   229→			"provider":       "claude",
   230→			"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
   231→			"command_path":   claudeCmd,
   232→			"error_type":     "unexpected_output",
   233→			"output":         strings.TrimSpace(output),
   234→		})
   235→
   236→		errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage("unexpected_output", claudeCmd, isCustomCommand, output)
   237→
   238→		return spi.CheckResult{
   239→			Success:      false,
   240→			Version:      "",
   241→			Location:     resolvedPath,
   242→			ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
   243→		}
   244→	}
   245→
   246→	// Success! Track it
   247→	pathType := getPathType(claudeCmd, resolvedPath)
   248→	analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
   249→		"provider":       "claude",
   250→		"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
   251→		"command_path":   resolvedPath,
   252→		"path_type":      pathType,
   253→		"version":        strings.TrimSpace(output),
   254→	})
   255→
   256→	return spi.CheckResult{
   257→		Success:      true,
   258→		Version:      strings.TrimSpace(output),
   259→		Location:     resolvedPath,
   260→		ErrorMessage: "",
   261→	}
   262→}

   264→// DetectAgent checks if Claude Code has been used in the given project directory
   265→func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {

   267→	claudeProjectPath, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)

   281→	// If helpOutput is requested, provide helpful guidance

   290→		log.UserMessage("Expected project folder: %s\n", claudeProjectPath)

   297→// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves all chat sessions for the given project path
   298→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   299→	// Get the Claude Code project directory
   300→	claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
   301→	if err != nil {
   302→		return nil, err
   303→	}
   304→
   305→	// Check if project directory exists
   306→	if _, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
   307→		return []spi.AgentChatSession{}, nil // No sessions if no project
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	// Parse JSONL files
   311→	parser := NewJSONLParser()
   312→	err = parser.ParseProjectSessions(claudeProjectDir, true) // silent = true
   313→	if err != nil {
   314→		return nil, err
   315→	}
   316→
   317→	// Convert sessions to AgentChatSession structs
   318→	result := make([]spi.AgentChatSession, 0, len(parser.Sessions))
   319→	for _, session := range parser.Sessions {
   320→		// Skip empty sessions (no records)
   321→		if len(session.Records) == 0 {
   322→			continue
   323→		}
   324→
   325→		// Process session (filter warmup, generate SessionData)
   326→		chatSession := processSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw)
   327→		if chatSession != nil {
   328→			result = append(result, *chatSession)
   329→		}
   330→	}
   331→
   332→	return result, nil
   333→}

   335→// GetAgentChatSession retrieves a single chat session by ID for the given project path
   336→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath string, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   337→	// Get the Claude Code project directory
   338→	claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
   339→	if err != nil {
   340→		return nil, err
   341→	}
   342→
   343→	// Check if project directory exists
   344→	if _, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
   345→		return nil, nil // No sessions if no project
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	// Parse only the session we're looking for
   349→	parser := NewJSONLParser()
   350→	err = parser.ParseSingleSession(claudeProjectDir, sessionID)
   351→	if err != nil {
   352→		// If session not found, return nil (not an error)
   353→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not found") {
   354→			return nil, nil
   355→		}
   356→		return nil, err
   357→	}
   358→
   359→	// Find the session
   360→	sessionPointer := parser.FindSession(sessionID)
   361→	if sessionPointer == nil {
   362→		return nil, nil
   363→	}
   364→	session := *sessionPointer
   365→
   366→	// Skip empty sessions (no records)
   367→	if len(session.Records) == 0 {
   368→		return nil, nil
   369→	}
   370→
   371→	// Process session (filter warmup, generate SessionData)
   372→	return processSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw), nil
   373→}

   375→// ExecAgentAndWatch executes Claude Code in interactive mode and watches for session updates
   376→func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   377→	slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Starting Claude Code execution and monitoring",
   378→		"projectPath", projectPath,
   379→		"customCommand", customCommand,
   380→		"resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID,
   381→		"debugRaw", debugRaw)
   382→
   383→	// Validate resume session ID if provided (Claude Code uses UUID format)
   384→	if resumeSessionID != "" {
   385→		resumeSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(resumeSessionID)
   386→		// Simple UUID validation for Claude Code sessions
   387→		if len(resumeSessionID) != 36 || !strings.Contains(resumeSessionID, "-") {
   388→			return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID format for Claude Code: %s (must be a UUID)", resumeSessionID)
   389→		}
   390→		slog.Info("Resuming Claude Code session", "sessionId", resumeSessionID)
   391→	}
   392→
   393→	// Set up the callback which enables real-time markdown generation and cloud sync during
   394→	// interactive sessions. As Claude Code writes JSONL updates, the watcher detects
   395→	// changes and invokes this callback, allowing immediate processing without blocking
   396→	// the agent's execution. The defer ensures cleanup when the agent exits.
   397→	SetWatcherCallback(sessionCallback)
   398→	defer ClearWatcherCallback()
   399→
   400→	// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
   401→	SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
   402→
   403→	// Start watching for project directory in the background
   404→	slog.Info("Initializing project directory monitoring...")
   405→
   406→	if err := WatchForProjectDir(); err != nil {
   407→		// Log the error but don't fail - watcher might work later
   408→		slog.Error("Failed to start project directory watcher", "error", err)
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	// Execute Claude Code - this blocks until Claude exits
   412→	slog.Info("Executing Claude Code", "command", customCommand)
   413→	err := ExecuteClaude(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
   414→
   415→	// Stop the watcher goroutine before returning
   416→	slog.Info("Claude Code has exited, stopping watcher")
   417→	StopWatcher()
   418→
   419→	// Return any execution error
   420→	if err != nil {
   421→		return fmt.Errorf("claude Code execution failed: %w", err)
   422→	}
   423→
   424→	return nil
   425→}
   426→
   427→// WatchAgent watches for Claude Code agent activity and calls the callback with AgentChatSession
   428→// Does NOT execute the agent - only watches for existing activity
   429→// Runs until error or context cancellation
   430→func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   431→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Starting Claude Code activity monitoring",
   432→		"projectPath", projectPath,
   433→		"debugRaw", debugRaw)
   434→
   435→	// The watcher callback directly passes AgentChatSession (which now contains SessionData)
   436→	wrappedCallback := func(agentChatSession *spi.AgentChatSession) {
   437→		slog.Debug("WatchAgent: Received AgentChatSession",
   438→			"sessionID", agentChatSession.SessionID,
   439→			"hasSessionData", agentChatSession.SessionData != nil)
   440→
   441→		// Call the user's callback with the AgentChatSession
   442→		sessionCallback(agentChatSession)
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	// Set up the callback for the watcher
   446→	SetWatcherCallback(wrappedCallback)
   447→	defer ClearWatcherCallback()
   448→
   449→	// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
   450→	SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
   451→
   452→	// Get the Claude Code project directory for the specified project path
   453→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Initializing project directory monitoring...")
   454→
   455→	claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
   456→	if err != nil {
   457→		slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to get Claude Code project directory", "error", err)
   458→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get project directory: %w", err)
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Project directory found", "directory", claudeProjectDir)
   462→
   463→	if err := startProjectWatcher(claudeProjectDir); err != nil {
   464→		slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to start project watcher", "error", err)
   465→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start watcher: %w", err)
   466→	}
   467→
   468→	// Block until context is cancelled
   469→	// The watcher runs in a background goroutine and will continue
   470→	// until context is cancelled or the process exits
   471→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Watcher started, blocking until context cancelled")
   472→
   473→	// Wait for context cancellation
   474→	<-ctx.Done()
   475→
   476→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Context cancelled, stopping watcher")
   477→	StopWatcher()
   478→
   479→	return ctx.Err()
   480→}

   482→// findFirstUserMessage finds the first user message in a session for slug generation
   483→// Returns empty string if no suitable user message is found
   484→func findFirstUserMessage(session Session) string {
   485→	for _, record := range session.Records {
   486→		// Check if this is a user message
   487→		if recordType, ok := record.Data["type"].(string); !ok || recordType != "user" {
   488→			continue
   489→		}
   490→
   491→		// Skip meta user messages
   492→		if isMeta, ok := record.Data["isMeta"].(bool); ok && isMeta {
   493→			continue
   494→		}
   495→
   496→		// Extract content from message
   497→		if message, ok := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   498→			if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   499→				// Skip messages containing "warmup" (case-insensitive)
   500→				if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(content), "warmup") {
   501→					continue
   502→				}
   503→				return content
   504→			}
   505→		}
   506→	}
   507→	return ""
   508→}
   509→
   510→// FileSlugFromRootRecord generates the slug part of the filename from the session
   511→// Returns the human-readable slug derived from the first user message, or empty string if none
   512→func FileSlugFromRootRecord(session Session) string {
   513→	// Find the first user message and generate slug from it
   514→	firstUserMessage := findFirstUserMessage(session)
   515→	slog.Debug("FileSlugFromRootRecord: First user message",
   516→		"sessionId", session.SessionUuid,
   517→		"message", firstUserMessage)
   518→
   519→	slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
   520→	slog.Debug("FileSlugFromRootRecord: Generated slug",
   521→		"sessionId", session.SessionUuid,
   522→		"slug", slug)
   523→
   524→	return slug
   525→}

   100→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")

   102→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure the Codex CLI is correctly installed\n")
   103→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running 'codex --version' directly in your terminal\n")
   104→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Check https://developers.openai.com/codex/quickstart for installation help\n")
   105→	}
   106→
   107→	return errorMsg.String()
   108→}
   109→
   110→// Check verifies OpenAI Codex CLI installation and returns version info.
   111→func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
   112→	codexCmd, _ := parseCodexCommand(customCommand)
   113→	isCustomCommand := customCommand != ""
   114→
   115→	resolvedPath := codexCmd
   116→	if !filepath.IsAbs(codexCmd) {
   117→		if path, err := exec.LookPath(codexCmd); err == nil {
   118→			resolvedPath = path
   119→		}
   120→	}
   121→
   122→	versionOutput, versionFlag, stderrOutput, err := runCodexVersionCommand(codexCmd)
   123→	if err != nil {
   124→		errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
   125→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
   126→			"provider":            "codex",
   127→			"custom_command":      isCustomCommand,
   128→			"command_path":        codexCmd,
   129→			"resolved_path":       resolvedPath,
   130→			"error_type":          errorType,
   131→			"version_flag":        versionFlag,
   132→			"stderr":              stderrOutput,
   133→			"error_message":       err.Error(),
   134→			"path_classification": classifyCodexPath(codexCmd, resolvedPath),
   135→		})
   136→
   137→		errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, codexCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
   138→
   139→		return spi.CheckResult{
   140→			Success:      false,
   141→			Version:      "",
   142→			Location:     resolvedPath,
   143→			ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
   144→		}
   145→	}
   146→
   147→	if versionOutput == "" {
   148→		errorType := "no_output"
   149→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
   150→			"provider":            "codex",
   151→			"custom_command":      isCustomCommand,
   152→			"command_path":        codexCmd,
   153→			"resolved_path":       resolvedPath,
   154→			"error_type":          errorType,
   155→			"version_flag":        versionFlag,
   156→			"stderr":              stderrOutput,
   157→			"path_classification": classifyCodexPath(codexCmd, resolvedPath),
   158→		})
   159→
   160→		errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, codexCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
   161→
   162→		return spi.CheckResult{
   163→			Success:      false,
   164→			Version:      "",
   165→			Location:     resolvedPath,
   166→			ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
   167→		}
   168→	}
   169→
   170→	pathType := classifyCodexPath(codexCmd, resolvedPath)
   171→	analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
   172→		"provider":       "codex",
   173→		"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
   174→		"command_path":   resolvedPath,
   175→		"path_type":      pathType,
   176→		"version":        versionOutput,
   177→		"version_flag":   versionFlag,
   178→	})
   179→
   180→	slog.Debug("Codex CLI check successful", "version", versionOutput, "location", resolvedPath, "flag", versionFlag)
   181→
   182→	return spi.CheckResult{
   183→		Success:      true,
   184→		Version:      versionOutput,
   185→		Location:     resolvedPath,
   186→		ErrorMessage: "",
   187→	}
   188→}

   190→// DetectAgent checks if OpenAI Codex CLI has been used in the given project path.
   191→func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
   192→	// Try to find sessions using the shared helper (stop on first match)
   193→	sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, "", true)
   194→
   195→	// Handle different error cases with helpful output
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		// Check if it's a home directory error
   198→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "home directory") {
   199→			slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Failed to resolve user home directory", "error", err)
   200→			if helpOutput {
   201→				fmt.Println()
   202→				log.UserWarn("Could not scan Codex CLI sessions for this directory.\n")
   203→				log.UserMessage("Reason: failed to determine your home directory.\n")
   204→				fmt.Println()
   205→			}
   206→			return false
   207→		}
   208→
   209→		// Check if it's a sessions directory error
   210→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions directory not accessible") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions root") {
   211→			homeDir, _ := osUserHomeDir()
   212→			sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
   213→
   214→			slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Codex sessions directory not accessible", "error", err)
   215→			if helpOutput {
   216→				fmt.Println()
   217→				log.UserWarn("No Codex CLI sessions were found for this directory.\n")
   218→				log.UserMessage("Codex CLI stores activity under ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/. We couldn't find that directory.\n\n")
   219→				log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
   220→				log.UserMessage("  1. Run `specstory run codex` to launch Codex CLI in this project\n")
   221→				log.UserMessage("  2. Or start Codex CLI manually, then run `specstory sync codex` afterward\n\n")
   222→				log.UserMessage("Expected sessions directory: %s\n", sessionsRoot)
   223→				fmt.Println()
   224→			}
   225→			return false
   226→		}
   227→
   228→		// Unknown error
   229→		slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Error finding sessions", "error", err)
   230→		return false
   231→	}
   232→
   233→	// Check if we found any sessions
   234→	if len(sessions) > 0 {
   235→		session := sessions[0]
   236→		slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Codex CLI activity detected",
   237→			"sessionID", session.SessionID,
   238→			"sessionPath", session.SessionPath)
   239→		return true
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	// No sessions found - provide helpful output
   243→	if helpOutput {
   244→		homeDir, _ := osUserHomeDir()
   245→		sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
   246→
   247→		fmt.Println()
   248→		log.UserWarn("No Codex CLI sessions were found for this directory.\n")
   249→		log.UserMessage("Codex CLI hasn't saved a session with this working directory yet.\n")
   250→		log.UserMessage("Codex stores sessions in ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/ as JSONL files.\n\n")
   251→		log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
   252→		log.UserMessage("  1. Run `specstory run codex` to launch Codex CLI here\n")
   253→		log.UserMessage("  2. Or open Codex CLI manually in this project, then try syncing again\n\n")
   254→		log.UserMessage("Checked sessions directory: %s\n", sessionsRoot)
   255→		fmt.Println()
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	return false
   259→}

   261→// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves chat sessions for the given project path.
   262→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   263→	// Find all sessions for this project (don't stop on first)
   264→	sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, "", false)
   265→	if err != nil {
   266→		// If sessions directory doesn't exist, return empty list (not an error)
   267→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions directory not accessible") ||
   268→			strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions root") ||
   269→			strings.Contains(err.Error(), "home directory") {
   270→			return []spi.AgentChatSession{}, nil
   271→		}
   272→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find codex sessions: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	// Convert to AgentChatSession structs
   276→	var result []spi.AgentChatSession
   277→	for _, sessionInfo := range sessions {
   278→		session, err := processSessionToAgentChat(&sessionInfo, projectPath, debugRaw)
   279→		if err != nil {
   280→			slog.Debug("GetAgentChatSessions: Failed to process session",
   281→				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
   282→				"error", err)
   283→			continue // Skip sessions we can't process
   284→		}
   285→
   286→		// Skip empty sessions (processSessionToAgentChat returns nil for empty sessions)
   287→		if session == nil {
   288→			slog.Debug("GetAgentChatSessions: Skipping empty session",
   289→				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID)
   290→			continue
   291→		}
   292→
   293→		result = append(result, *session)
   294→	}
   295→
   296→	return result, nil
   297→}
   298→
   299→// GetAgentChatSession retrieves a chat session by ID.
   300→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath string, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   301→	// Find the specific session (will short-circuit when found)
   302→	sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, sessionID, false)
   303→	if err != nil {
   304→		// If sessions directory doesn't exist, return nil (not an error)
   305→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions directory not accessible") ||
   306→			strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions root") ||
   307→			strings.Contains(err.Error(), "home directory") {
   308→			return nil, nil
   309→		}
   310→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find codex sessions: %w", err)
   311→	}
   312→
   313→	// Session not found (empty result)
   314→	if len(sessions) == 0 {
   315→		return nil, nil
   316→	}
   317→
   318→	// Process the first (and only) session using shared helper
   319→	return processSessionToAgentChat(&sessions[0], projectPath, debugRaw)
   320→}
