   322→// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the Codex CLI in interactive mode and monitors for session updates.
   323→// The function blocks until the Codex CLI exits. During execution, it watches for JSONL file changes
   324→// and invokes sessionCallback for each update, enabling real-time markdown generation and cloud sync.
   325→func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   326→	slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Starting Codex CLI execution and monitoring",
   327→		"projectPath", projectPath,
   328→		"customCommand", customCommand,
   329→		"resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID,
   330→		"debugRaw", debugRaw)
   331→
   332→	// Log if resuming a specific session
   333→	if resumeSessionID != "" {
   334→		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Will resume specific Codex session", "sessionID", resumeSessionID)
   335→	}
   336→
   337→	// Set up the callback which enables real-time markdown generation and cloud sync during
   338→	// interactive sessions. As Codex CLI writes JSONL updates, the watcher detects changes
   339→	// and invokes this callback, allowing immediate processing without blocking the agent's
   340→	// execution. The defer ensures cleanup when the agent exits.
   341→	SetWatcherCallback(sessionCallback)
   342→	defer ClearWatcherCallback()
   343→
   344→	// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
   345→	SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
   346→
   347→	// Start watching for Codex sessions in the background
   348→	slog.Info("Initializing Codex session monitoring...")
   349→
   350→	if err := WatchForCodexSessions(projectPath, resumeSessionID); err != nil {
   351→		// Log the error but don't fail - watcher might work later
   352→		slog.Error("Failed to start Codex session watcher", "error", err)
   353→	}
   354→
   355→	// Execute Codex CLI - this blocks until Codex exits
   356→	slog.Info("Executing Codex CLI", "command", customCommand, "resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID)
   357→	err := ExecuteCodex(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
   358→
   359→	// Stop the watcher goroutine and wait for it to finish before returning
   360→	slog.Info("Codex CLI has exited, stopping watcher")
   361→	StopWatcher()
   362→
   363→	// Return any execution error
   364→	if err != nil {
   365→		return fmt.Errorf("codex CLI execution failed: %w", err)
   366→	}
   367→
   368→	return nil
   369→}
   370→
   371→// WatchAgent watches for Codex CLI agent activity and calls the callback with AgentChatSession
   372→// Does NOT execute the agent - only watches for existing activity
   373→// Runs until error or context cancellation (blocks indefinitely)
   374→func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   375→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Starting Codex CLI activity monitoring",
   376→		"projectPath", projectPath,
   377→		"debugRaw", debugRaw)
   378→
   379→	// The watcher callback directly passes AgentChatSession (which now contains SessionData)
   380→	wrappedCallback := func(agentChatSession *spi.AgentChatSession) {
   381→		slog.Debug("WatchAgent: Received AgentChatSession",
   382→			"sessionID", agentChatSession.SessionID,
   383→			"hasSessionData", agentChatSession.SessionData != nil)
   384→
   385→		// Call the user's callback with the AgentChatSession
   386→		sessionCallback(agentChatSession)
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	// Set up the callback for the watcher
   390→	SetWatcherCallback(wrappedCallback)
   391→	defer ClearWatcherCallback()
   392→
   393→	// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
   394→	SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
   395→
   396→	// Start watching for Codex sessions in the background
   397→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Initializing Codex session monitoring...")
   398→
   399→	if err := WatchForCodexSessions(projectPath, ""); err != nil {
   400→		slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to start Codex session watcher", "error", err)
   401→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start watcher: %w", err)
   402→	}
   403→
   404→	// Block until context is cancelled
   405→	// The watcher runs in a background goroutine and will continue
   406→	// until context is cancelled or the process exits
   407→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Watcher started, blocking until context cancelled")
   408→
   409→	// Wait for context cancellation
   410→	<-ctx.Done()
   411→
   412→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Context cancelled, stopping watcher")
   413→	StopWatcher()
   414→
   415→	return ctx.Err()
   416→}
   417→
   418→// findCodexSessions traverses the Codex CLI sessions directory structure and finds
   419→// sessions that match the given project path.
   420→//
   421→// Short-circuit behavior:
   422→//   - If targetSessionID is provided: stops when that specific session is found (ignores stopOnFirst)
   423→//   - If targetSessionID is empty and stopOnFirst is true: stops after finding first matching session
   424→//   - If targetSessionID is empty and stopOnFirst is false: returns all matching sessions
   425→func findCodexSessions(projectPath string, targetSessionID string, stopOnFirst bool) ([]codexSessionInfo, error) {
   426→	normalizedProjectPath := normalizeCodexPath(projectPath)
   427→	if normalizedProjectPath == "" {
   428→		slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Unable to normalize project path", "projectPath", projectPath)
   429→	}
   430→
   431→	homeDir, err := osUserHomeDir()
   432→	if err != nil {
   433→		slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to resolve user home directory", "error", err)
   434→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to determine home directory: %w", err)
   435→	}
   436→
   437→	sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
   438→	rootInfo, err := os.Stat(sessionsRoot)
   439→	if err != nil {
   440→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   441→			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex sessions directory not found", "path", sessionsRoot)
   442→		} else {
   443→			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to stat Codex sessions directory", "path", sessionsRoot, "error", err)
   444→		}
   445→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions directory not accessible: %w", err)
   446→	}
   447→
   448→	if !rootInfo.IsDir() {
   449→		slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex sessions root is not a directory", "path", sessionsRoot)
   450→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions root is not a directory: %s", sessionsRoot)
   451→	}
   452→
   453→	yearEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(sessionsRoot)
   454→	if err != nil {
   455→		slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex sessions root", "path", sessionsRoot, "error", err)
   456→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read sessions root: %w", err)
   457→	}
   458→
   459→	var sessions []codexSessionInfo
   460→
   461→	// Traverse year/month/day directory structure
   462→	for _, yearEntry := range yearEntries {
   463→		if !yearEntry.IsDir() {
   464→			continue
   465→		}
   466→
   467→		yearPath := filepath.Join(sessionsRoot, yearEntry.Name())
   468→		monthEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(yearPath)
   469→		if err != nil {
   470→			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex year directory", "path", yearPath, "error", err)
   471→			continue
   472→		}
   473→
   474→		for _, monthEntry := range monthEntries {
   475→			if !monthEntry.IsDir() {
   476→				continue
   477→			}
   478→
   479→			monthPath := filepath.Join(yearPath, monthEntry.Name())
   480→			dayEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(monthPath)
   481→			if err != nil {
   482→				slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex month directory", "path", monthPath, "error", err)
   483→				continue
   484→			}
   485→
   486→			for _, dayEntry := range dayEntries {
   487→				if !dayEntry.IsDir() {
   488→					continue
   489→				}
   490→
   491→				dayPath := filepath.Join(monthPath, dayEntry.Name())
   492→				sessionEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(dayPath)
   493→				if err != nil {
   494→					slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex day directory", "path", dayPath, "error", err)
   495→					continue
   496→				}
   497→
   498→				for _, sessionEntry := range sessionEntries {
   499→					if sessionEntry.IsDir() {
   500→						continue
   501→					}
   502→					if filepath.Ext(sessionEntry.Name()) != ".jsonl" {
   503→						continue
   504→					}
   505→
   506→					sessionPath := filepath.Join(dayPath, sessionEntry.Name())
   507→					meta, err := loadCodexSessionMeta(sessionPath)
   508→					if err != nil {
   509→						slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to load Codex session meta", "path", sessionPath, "error", err)
   510→						continue
   511→					}
   512→
   513→					sessionID := strings.TrimSpace(meta.Payload.ID)
   514→					normalizedCWD := normalizeCodexPath(meta.Payload.CWD)
   515→					if normalizedCWD == "" {
   516→						slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Session meta missing cwd", "sessionID", sessionID, "path", sessionPath)
   517→						continue
   518→					}
   519→
   520→					// Check if this session matches the project path
   521→					matched := false
   522→					if normalizedProjectPath != "" {
   523→						if normalizedCWD == normalizedProjectPath || strings.EqualFold(normalizedCWD, normalizedProjectPath) {
   524→							matched = true
   525→						}
   526→					} else if normalizedCWD == projectPath || strings.EqualFold(normalizedCWD, projectPath) {
   527→						matched = true
   528→					}
   529→
   530→					if matched {
   531→						// If we're searching for a specific session, skip sessions that don't match
   532→						if targetSessionID != "" && sessionID != targetSessionID {
   533→							continue
   534→						}
   535→
   536→						slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex CLI session matched project",
   537→							"sessionID", sessionID,
   538→							"sessionPath", sessionPath)
   539→
   540→						sessions = append(sessions, codexSessionInfo{
   541→							SessionID:   sessionID,
   542→							SessionPath: sessionPath,
   543→							Meta:        meta,
   544→						})
   545→
   546→						// Short-circuit logic:
   547→						// 1. If we have a target sessionID and this matches, we're done
   548→						if targetSessionID != "" && sessionID == targetSessionID {
   549→							slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Found target session, stopping search", "sessionID", targetSessionID)
   550→							return sessions, nil
   551→						}
   552→
   553→						// 2. If stopOnFirst is true (and no target sessionID), return first match
   554→						if targetSessionID == "" && stopOnFirst {
   555→							return sessions, nil
   556→						}
   557→
   558→						// 3. Otherwise, continue collecting all matching sessions
   559→					}
   560→				}
   561→			}
   562→		}
   563→	}
   564→
   565→	return sessions, nil
   566→}
   567→
   568→// readSessionRawData reads all JSONL lines from a Codex CLI session file and returns
   569→// both the parsed records and the raw JSONL content.
   570→func readSessionRawData(sessionPath string) ([]map[string]interface{}, string, error) {
   571→	file, err := os.Open(sessionPath)
   572→	if err != nil {
   573→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
   574→	}
   575→	defer func() {
   576→		_ = file.Close()
   577→	}()
   578→
   579→	var records []map[string]interface{}
   580→	var rawBuilder strings.Builder
   581→
   582→	// Use bufio.Reader instead of Scanner to handle arbitrarily large lines
   583→	// Scanner has a token size limit (even with custom buffer), but Reader does not
   584→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   585→
   586→	lineNumber := 0
   587→	for {
   588→		// Read line using ReadString which has no size limit
   589→		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   590→		line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
   591→
   592→		// EOF is expected at end of file, other errors are genuine failures
   593→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
   594→			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("error reading line %d: %w", lineNumber+1, err)
   595→		}
   596→
   597→		// Determine if we're at end of file and if we have content to process
   598→		atEOF := err == io.EOF
   599→		hasContent := len(line) > 0
   600→
   601→		// Increment line number for every line read (including empty lines) to match text editor line numbers
   602→		if hasContent || !atEOF {
   603→			lineNumber++
   604→		}
   605→
   606→		// If no content, either skip empty line or exit at EOF
   607→		if !hasContent {
   608→			if atEOF {
   609→				break // Reached end of file with no content
   610→			}
   611→			continue // Empty line in middle of file, skip it
   612→		}
   613→
   614→		// Sanity check to prevent OOM from pathological files
   615→		if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
   616→			slog.Warn("line exceeds reasonable size limit",
   617→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   618→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   619→				"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB,
   620→				"file", filepath.Base(sessionPath))
   621→			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB): refusing to process potentially malformed file",
   622→				lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
   623→		}
   624→
   625→		// Log when processing unusually large lines (helps debug performance issues)
   626→		if len(line) > 10*MB {
   627→			slog.Debug("processing large JSONL line",
   628→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   629→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   630→				"file", filepath.Base(sessionPath))
   631→		}
   632→
   633→		// Trim whitespace and skip empty lines
   634→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   635→		if line == "" {
   636→			if atEOF {
   637→				break
   638→			}
   639→			continue
   640→		}
   641→
   642→		// Add to raw data
   643→		rawBuilder.WriteString(line)
   644→		rawBuilder.WriteString("\n")
   645→
   646→		// Parse JSON
   647→		var record map[string]interface{}
   648→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); err != nil {
   649→			// Log warning and skip corrupted lines rather than failing entire parse
   650→			slog.Warn("Skipping corrupted JSONL line",
   651→				"file", filepath.Base(sessionPath),
   652→				"line", lineNumber,
   653→				"error", err)
   654→			if atEOF {
   655→				break
   656→			}
   657→			continue
   658→		}
   659→
   660→		records = append(records, record)
   661→
   662→		// After processing record, check if we're done
   663→		if atEOF {
   664→			break
   665→		}
   666→	}
   667→
   668→	return records, rawBuilder.String(), nil
   669→}
   670→
   671→// loadCodexSessionMeta reads the first JSON line from a session file and parses the session metadata.
   672→func loadCodexSessionMeta(sessionPath string) (*codexSessionMeta, error) {
   673→	file, err := os.Open(sessionPath)
   674→	if err != nil {
   675→		return nil, err
   676→	}
   677→	defer func() {
   678→		_ = file.Close()
   679→	}()
   680→
   681→	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
   682→	if !scanner.Scan() {
   683→		if scanErr := scanner.Err(); scanErr != nil {
   684→			return nil, scanErr
   685→		}
   686→		return nil, errors.New("codex session meta not found")
   687→	}
   688→
   689→	line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
   690→	if line == "" {
   691→		return nil, errors.New("codex session meta is empty")
   692→	}
   693→
   694→	var meta codexSessionMeta
   695→	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &meta); err != nil {
   696→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse codex session meta: %w", err)
   697→	}
   698→
   699→	if meta.Type != "session_meta" {
   700→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected codex session record type: %s", meta.Type)
   701→	}
   702→
   703→	return &meta, nil
   704→}
   705→
   706→// processSessionToAgentChat converts a codexSessionInfo into an AgentChatSession by reading
   707→// the session data, generating SessionData, and optionally writing debug files. Returns nil if
   708→// the session is empty or cannot be read.
   709→func processSessionToAgentChat(sessionInfo *codexSessionInfo, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   710→	// Read the session data
   711→	records, rawData, err := readSessionRawData(sessionInfo.SessionPath)
   712→	if err != nil {
   713→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session data: %w", err)
   714→	}
   715→
   716→	// Skip empty sessions
   717→	if len(records) == 0 {
   718→		return nil, nil
   719→	}
   720→
   721→	// Get timestamp from metadata
   722→	timestamp := sessionInfo.Meta.Timestamp
   723→
   724→	// Generate slug from first user message
   725→	firstUserMessage := findFirstUserMessage(records)
   726→	slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
   727→	if slug == "" {
   728→		slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: No user message for slug yet",
   729→			"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID)
   730→	} else {
   731→		slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: Generated slug from user message",
   732→			"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
   733→			"slug", slug)
   734→	}
   735→
   736→	// Generate SessionData from records
   737→	sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(records, workspaceRoot)
   738→	if err != nil {
   739→		slog.Error("Failed to generate SessionData", "sessionId", sessionInfo.SessionID, "error", err)
   740→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate SessionData: %w", err)
   741→	}
   742→
   743→	// Write provider-specific debug files if requested
   744→	if debugRaw {
   745→		if err := writeDebugRawFiles(sessionInfo.SessionID, records); err != nil {
   746→			slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: Failed to write debug files",
   747→				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
   748→				"error", err)
   749→			// Don't fail the operation if debug output fails
   750→		}
   751→	}
   752→
   753→	return &spi.AgentChatSession{
   754→		SessionID:   sessionInfo.SessionID,
   755→		CreatedAt:   timestamp,
   756→		Slug:        slug,
   757→		SessionData: sessionData,
   758→		RawData:     rawData,
   759→	}, nil
   760→}
   761→
   762→// writeDebugRawFiles writes debug JSON files for a Codex CLI session.
   763→// Each record is written as a numbered JSON file in .specstory/debug/<session-id>/
   764→func writeDebugRawFiles(sessionID string, records []map[string]interface{}) error {
   765→	// Get the debug directory path
   766→	debugDir := spi.GetDebugDir(sessionID)
   767→
   768→	// Create the debug directory
   769→	if err := os.MkdirAll(debugDir, 0755); err != nil {
   770→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create debug directory: %w", err)
   771→	}
   772→
   773→	// Write each record as a pretty-printed JSON file
   774→	for index, record := range records {
   775→		// Create filename with 1-based index for readability
   776→		filename := fmt.Sprintf("%d.json", index+1)
   777→		debugPath := filepath.Join(debugDir, filename)
   778→
   779→		// Pretty print the record
   780→		prettyJSON, err := json.MarshalIndent(record, "", "  ")
   781→		if err != nil {
   782→			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Failed to marshal record to JSON",
   783→				"index", index,
   784→				"error", err)
   785→			continue
   786→		}
   787→
   788→		// Write the file
   789→		if err := os.WriteFile(debugPath, prettyJSON, 0644); err != nil {
   790→			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Failed to write debug file",
   791→				"path", debugPath,
   792→				"error", err)
   793→			continue
   794→		}
   795→
   796→		slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Wrote debug file",
   797→			"path", debugPath,
   798→			"index", index)
   799→	}
   800→
   801→	return nil
   802→}
   803→
   804→// findFirstUserMessage extracts the first user message from Codex CLI session records.
   805→// Returns empty string if no user message is found.
   806→func findFirstUserMessage(records []map[string]interface{}) string {
   807→	for _, record := range records {
   808→		// Get record type
   809→		recordType, ok := record["type"].(string)
   810→		if !ok || recordType != "event_msg" {
   811→			continue
   812→		}
   813→
   814→		// Get payload
   815→		payload, ok := record["payload"].(map[string]interface{})
   816→		if !ok {
   817→			continue
   818→		}
   819→
   820→		// Check if this is a user message
   821→		payloadType, ok := payload["type"].(string)
   822→		if !ok || payloadType != "user_message" {
   823→			continue
   824→		}
   825→
   826→		// Extract the message content
   827→		message, ok := payload["message"].(string)
   828→		if !ok || message == "" {
   829→			continue
   830→		}
   831→
   832→		// Found the first user message
   833→		slog.Debug("findFirstUserMessage: Found first user message",
   834→			"message", message[:min(len(message), 100)])
   835→		return message
   836→	}
   837→
   838→	slog.Debug("findFirstUserMessage: No user message found in session")
   839→	return ""
   840→}

    35→// Check verifies that the Droid CLI is available and returns its resolved
    36→// location and version information based on the provided custom command override.
    37→func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
    38→	cmdName, _ := parseDroidCommand(customCommand)
    39→	isCustom := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != ""
    40→	versionFlag := "--version"
    41→
    42→	resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
    43→	if err != nil {
    44→		msg := buildCheckErrorMessage("not_found", cmdName, isCustom, "")
    45→		trackCheckFailure("droid", isCustom, cmdName, "", classifyDroidPath(cmdName, ""), versionFlag, "", "not_found", err.Error())
    46→		return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, Location: "", ErrorMessage: msg}
    47→	}
    48→	pathType := classifyDroidPath(cmdName, resolved)
    49→
    50→	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
    51→	cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
    52→	cmd.Stdout = &stdout
    53→	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
    54→	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
    55→		errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
    56→		stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
    57→		msg := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, resolved, isCustom, stderrOutput)
    58→		trackCheckFailure("droid", isCustom, cmdName, resolved, pathType, versionFlag, stderrOutput, errorType, err.Error())
    59→		return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, Location: resolved, ErrorMessage: msg}
    60→	}
    61→
    62→	versionOutput := sanitizeDroidVersion(stdout.String())
    63→	version := extractDroidVersion(versionOutput)
    64→	if version == "" {
    65→		version = strings.TrimSpace(versionOutput)
    66→	}
    67→	trackCheckSuccess("droid", isCustom, cmdName, resolved, pathType, version, versionFlag)
    68→	return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
    69→}

   105→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {

   148→// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the Factory Droid CLI agent for the given project and,
   149→// when a session callback is provided, watches for new or updated chat sessions and
   150→// invokes the callback as they are discovered.
   151→func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   152→	if sessionCallback == nil {
   153→		return ExecuteDroid(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
   154→	}
   155→
   156→	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
   157→	defer cancel()
   158→
   159→	watchErr := make(chan error, 1)
   160→	go func() {
   161→		watchErr <- watchSessions(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
   162→	}()
   163→
   164→	err := ExecuteDroid(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
   165→	cancel()
   166→
   167→	if werr := <-watchErr; werr != nil && !errors.Is(werr, context.Canceled) {
   168→		slog.Warn("droidcli: watcher stopped with error", "error", werr)
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	if err != nil {
   172→		return fmt.Errorf("factory droid CLI execution failed: %w", err)
   173→	}
   174→	return nil
   175→}

   214→func classifyCheckError(err error) string {
   215→	var execErr *exec.Error
   216→	var pathErr *os.PathError
   217→	switch {
   218→	case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
   219→		return "not_found"
   220→	case errors.As(err, &pathErr) && errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission):
   221→		return "permission_denied"
   222→	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
   223→		return "permission_denied"
   224→	default:
   225→		return "version_failed"
   226→	}
   227→}
   228→
   229→func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, command string, isCustom bool, stderr string) string {
   230→	var builder strings.Builder
   231→	switch errorType {
   232→	case "not_found":
   233→		builder.WriteString("Factory Droid CLI was not found.\n\n")
   234→		if isCustom {
   235→			builder.WriteString("• Verify the custom path you provided is executable.\n")
   236→			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("• Provided command: %s\n", command))
   237→		} else {
   238→			builder.WriteString("• Install the Factory CLI and ensure `droid` is on your PATH.\n")
   239→			builder.WriteString("• Re-run `specstory check droid` after installation.\n")
   240→		}
   241→	case "permission_denied":
   242→		builder.WriteString("SpecStory cannot execute the Factory CLI due to permissions.\n\n")
   243→		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Try: chmod +x %s\n", command))
   244→	default:
   245→		builder.WriteString("`droid --version` failed.\n\n")
   246→		if stderr != "" {
   247→			builder.WriteString("Error output:\n")
   248→			builder.WriteString(stderr)
   249→			builder.WriteString("\n\n")
   250→		}
   251→		builder.WriteString("Run `droid --version` manually to diagnose, then retry.")
   252→	}
   253→	return builder.String()
   254→}

   258→func sanitizeDroidVersion(raw string) string {

   264→func extractDroidVersion(raw string) string {

   310→func classifyDroidPath(command string, resolvedPath string) string {
   311→	if resolvedPath == "" {
   312→		if filepath.IsAbs(command) {
   313→			return "absolute_path"
   314→		}
   315→		return "unknown"
   316→	}
   317→	resolvedLower := strings.ToLower(resolvedPath)
   318→	if strings.Contains(resolvedLower, "homebrew") || strings.Contains(resolvedLower, "/opt/homebrew/") {
   319→		return "homebrew"
   320→	}
   321→	if strings.Contains(resolvedLower, "/.local/bin/") {
   322→		return "user_local"
   323→	}
   324→	if strings.Contains(resolvedLower, "/.factory/") {
   325→		return "factory_local"
   326→	}
   327→	if filepath.IsAbs(command) {
   328→		return "absolute_path"
   329→	}
   330→	return "system_path"
   331→}

   338→func sessionMentionsProject(filePath string, projectPath string) bool {
   339→	projectPath = strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
   340→	if projectPath == "" {
   341→		return false
   342→	}
   343→
   344→	canonicalProject := canonicalizePath(projectPath)
   345→	if sessionRoot := extractSessionWorkspaceRoot(filePath); sessionRoot != "" {
   346→		canonicalRoot := canonicalizePath(sessionRoot)
   347→		if canonicalProject != "" && canonicalRoot != "" {
   348→			return canonicalRoot == canonicalProject
   349→		}
   350→		return strings.TrimSpace(sessionRoot) == projectPath
   351→	}
   352→
   353→	return sessionMentionsProjectText(filePath, projectPath)

   356→func extractSessionWorkspaceRoot(filePath string) string {
   357→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   358→	if err != nil {
   359→		return ""
   360→	}
   361→	defer func() {
   362→		_ = file.Close()
   363→	}()
   364→
   365→	var workspaceRoot string
   366→	scanErr := scanLines(file, func(_ int, line string) error {
   367→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   368→		if trimmed == "" {
   369→			return nil
   370→		}
   371→		var env jsonlEnvelope
   372→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &env); err != nil {
   373→			return nil
   374→		}
   375→		if env.Type != "session_start" {
   376→			return nil
   377→		}
   378→		var event sessionStartEvent
   379→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {
   380→			return nil
   381→		}
   382→		workspaceRoot = firstNonEmpty(event.CWD, event.WorkspaceRoot, event.Session.CWD, event.Session.WorkspaceRoot)
   383→		return errStopScan
   384→	})
   385→	if scanErr != nil && !errors.Is(scanErr, errStopScan) {
   386→		return ""
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	return strings.TrimSpace(workspaceRoot)
   390→}

   392→func canonicalizePath(path string) string {
   393→	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
   394→	if trimmed == "" {
   395→		return ""
   396→	}
   397→	canonical, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(trimmed)
   398→	if err == nil {
   399→		return canonical
   400→	}
   401→	if abs, absErr := filepath.Abs(trimmed); absErr == nil {
   402→		return filepath.Clean(abs)
   403→	}
   404→	return filepath.Clean(trimmed)
   405→}

   407→func sessionMentionsProjectText(filePath string, projectPath string) bool {
   408→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   409→	if err != nil {
   410→		return false
   411→	}
   412→	defer func() {
   413→		_ = file.Close()
   414→	}()
   415→	needle := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
   416→	short := filepath.Base(projectPath)
   417→	foundLines := 0
   418→	err = scanLines(file, func(_ int, line string) error {
   419→		if needle != "" && strings.Contains(line, needle) {
   420→			return errStopScan
   421→		}
   422→		if short != "" && strings.Contains(line, short) {
   423→			foundLines++
   424→			if foundLines > 2 {
   425→				return errStopScan
   426→			}
   427→		}
   428→		return nil
   429→	})
   430→
   431→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStopScan) {
   432→		slog.Warn("error scanning session file", "path", filePath, "err", err)
   433→		return false
   434→	}
   435→
   436→	return errors.Is(err, errStopScan)
   437→}

   439→// writeFactoryDebugRaw writes pretty-printed JSON files for each line in the session's JSONL.
   440→// Each JSONL line becomes a numbered file (1.json, 2.json, etc.) matching the Claude Code provider format.
   441→func writeFactoryDebugRaw(session *fdSession) error {
   442→	if session == nil {
   443→		return nil
   444→	}
   445→
   446→	dir := spi.GetDebugDir(session.ID)
   447→	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
   448→		return fmt.Errorf("droidcli: unable to create debug dir: %w", err)
   449→	}
   450→
   451→	// Clean existing files from the debug directory
   452→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
   453→	if err == nil {
   454→		for _, entry := range entries {
   455→			if !entry.IsDir() {
   456→				_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(dir, entry.Name()))
   457→			}
   458→		}
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	// Split JSONL into individual lines and write each as a pretty-printed JSON file
   462→	lines := strings.Split(session.RawData, "\n")
   463→	lineNumber := 0
   464→	for _, line := range lines {
   465→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   466→		if trimmed == "" {
   467→			continue
   468→		}
   469→
   470→		// Parse the JSON line
   471→		var data map[string]interface{}
   472→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &data); err != nil {
   473→			slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed JSONL line in debug-raw",
   474→				"lineNumber", lineNumber+1,
   475→				"error", err)
   476→			continue
   477→		}
   478→
   479→		lineNumber++
   480→
   481→		// Pretty-print and write to numbered file
   482→		prettyJSON, err := json.MarshalIndent(data, "", "  ")
   483→		if err != nil {
   484→			slog.Debug("droidcli: failed to marshal JSON for debug-raw",
   485→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   486→				"error", err)
   487→			continue
   488→		}
   489→
   490→		filePath := filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("%d.json", lineNumber))
   491→		if err := os.WriteFile(filePath, prettyJSON, 0o644); err != nil {
   492→			slog.Debug("droidcli: failed to write debug-raw file",
   493→				"path", filePath,
   494→				"error", err)
   495→		}
   496→	}
   497→
   498→	slog.Debug("droidcli: wrote debug-raw files",
   499→		"sessionId", session.ID,
   500→		"fileCount", lineNumber)
   501→
   502→	return nil
   503→}

   117→		NoteProgress(silent)

   119→	})
   120→
   121→	if err != nil {

   123→	}
   124→	scanDuration := time.Since(scanStartTime)
   125→	slog.Info("ParseProjectSessions: File scanning completed", "duration", formatDuration(scanDuration), "records", len(allRecords))
   126→
   127→	if !silent {
   128→		fmt.Print("\nProcessing JSONL files")

   131→	// Step 2: Eliminate duplicates by uuid (keep earliest by timestamp)

   134→	uniqueRecords := p.eliminateDuplicates(allRecords)
   135→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: After deduplication", "uniqueRecords", len(uniqueRecords))
   136→	dedupDuration := time.Since(dedupStartTime)

   154→	mergeStartTime := time.Now()

   156→	mergeDuration := time.Since(mergeStartTime)
   157→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: DAG merging completed", "duration", formatDuration(mergeDuration),
   158→		"beforeCount", len(dags), "afterCount", len(mergedDags))

   230→// extractSessionIDFromFile reads a JSONL file and returns the first sessionId found.
   231→// Uses regex for fast extraction without full JSON parsing.
   232→// Returns empty string if no sessionId is found.
   233→func extractSessionIDFromFile(filePath string) (string, error) {
   234→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   235→	if err != nil {
   236→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open file: %w", err)
   237→	}
   238→	defer func() { _ = file.Close() }()
   239→
   240→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   241→
   242→	for {
   243→		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   244→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
   245→			return "", fmt.Errorf("error reading file: %w", err)
   246→		}
   247→
   248→		// Try to find sessionId via regex (faster than JSON parsing)
   249→		if matches := sessionIDRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(matches) > 1 {
   250→			return matches[1], nil
   251→		}
   252→
   253→		if err == io.EOF {
   254→			break
   255→		}
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	return "", nil
   259→}

   264→	if err := p.ParseProjectSessionsForSession(projectPath, true, sessionUuid); err != nil {

   267→
   268→	// Filter to just the requested session
   269→	filteredSessions := []Session{}
   270→	for _, session := range p.Sessions {

   273→		}
   274→	}
   275→
   276→	if len(filteredSessions) == 0 {
   277→		return fmt.Errorf("no session found for UUID %s", sessionUuid)
   278→	}
   279→
   280→	p.Sessions = filteredSessions
   281→	return nil
   282→}

   284→// parseSessionFile parses a single JSONL file and handles summaries and sidechains
   285→func (p *JSONLParser) parseSessionFile(filePath string) ([]JSONLRecord, error) {
   286→	slog.Info("Parsing session file", "file", filePath)
   287→
   288→	// Clean debug directory for jsonl-burst mode only
   289→	// (specstory-burst cleaning happens later during markdown generation)
   290→	if GetJsonlBurst() {
   291→		uuid := ExtractUUIDFromFilename(filePath)
   292→		if err := CleanDebugDirectory(uuid); err != nil {
   293→			slog.Warn("Failed to clean debug directory", "error", err)
   294→		}
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   298→	if err != nil {
   299→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open file: %w", err)
   300→	}
   301→	defer func() { _ = file.Close() }() // Read-only file; close errors not actionable
   302→
   303→	// Use bufio.Reader instead of Scanner to handle arbitrarily large lines
   304→	// Scanner has a token size limit (even with custom buffer), but Reader does not
   305→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   306→
   307→	lineNumber := 0
   308→	records := []JSONLRecord{}
   309→	var lastNonSummaryRecord *JSONLRecord
   310→	// pendingSummary holds a summary string when it appears before any records in the file.
   311→	// This happens when the summary is on line 1 - we can't attach it to a previous record
   312→	// because none exists yet, so we hold it and attach it to the next record we process.
   313→	var pendingSummary string
   314→
   315→	for {
   316→		// Read line using ReadString which has no size limit
   317→		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   318→		line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
   319→
   320→		// EOF is expected at end of file, other errors are genuine failures
   321→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
   322→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("error reading line %d: %w", lineNumber+1, err)
   323→		}
   324→
   325→		// Determine if we're at end of file and if we have content to process
   326→		atEOF := err == io.EOF
   327→		hasContent := len(line) > 0
   328→
   329→		// Increment line number for every line read (including empty lines) to match text editor line numbers
   330→		if hasContent || !atEOF {
   331→			lineNumber++
   332→		}
   333→
   334→		// If no content, either skip empty line or exit at EOF
   335→		if !hasContent {
   336→			if atEOF {
   337→				break // Reached end of file with no content
   338→			}
   339→			continue // Empty line in middle of file, skip it
   340→		}
   341→
   342→		// Sanity check to prevent OOM from pathological files
   343→		if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
   344→			slog.Warn("line exceeds reasonable size limit",
   345→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   346→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   347→				"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB,
   348→				"file", filepath.Base(filePath))
   349→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB): refusing to process potentially malformed file",
   350→				lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
   351→		}
   352→
   353→		// Log when processing unusually large lines (helps debug performance issues)
   354→		if len(line) > 10*MB {
   355→			slog.Debug("processing large JSONL line",
   356→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   357→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   358→				"file", filepath.Base(filePath))
   359→		}
   360→
   361→		var data map[string]interface{}
   362→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &data); err != nil {
   363→			// Log warning and skip corrupted lines rather than failing entire parse
   364→			slog.Warn("Skipping corrupted JSONL line",
   365→				"file", filepath.Base(filePath),
   366→				"line", lineNumber,
   367→				"error", err)
   368→			if atEOF {
   369→				break
   370→			}
   371→			continue
   372→		}
   373→
   374→		// Write debug JSON if jsonl-burst mode is enabled
   375→		_ = WriteDebugJSON(filePath, lineNumber, data) // Debug feature; errors don't affect parsing
   376→
   377→		// Check if this is a summary line
   378→		if data["type"] == "summary" {
   379→			if len(records) > 0 && lastNonSummaryRecord != nil {
   380→				// Add summary to the last non-summary record
   381→				lastNonSummaryRecord.Data["summary"] = data
   382→			} else {
   383→				// No previous record exists (summary is on line 1), so store it for the next record
   384→				if summaryText, ok := data["summary"].(string); ok {
   385→					pendingSummary = summaryText
   386→				}
   387→			}
   388→			// After processing summary, check if we're done
   389→			if atEOF {
   390→				break
   391→			}
   392→			continue // Don't add summary as a separate record
   393→		}
   394→
   395→		// Handle sidechain parentUuid update
   396→		if isSidechain, ok := data["isSidechain"].(bool); ok && isSidechain {
   397→			if data["parentUuid"] == nil && lastNonSummaryRecord != nil {
   398→				// Update parentUuid to the uuid of the prior record
   399→				if uuid, ok := lastNonSummaryRecord.Data["uuid"].(string); ok {
   400→					data["parentUuid"] = uuid
   401→				}
   402→			}
   403→		}
   404→
   405→		// If we have a pending summary from line 1, attach it to this first record
   406→		if pendingSummary != "" {
   407→			data["summary"] = map[string]interface{}{
   408→				"summary": pendingSummary,
   409→			}
   410→			pendingSummary = "" // Clear it so we don't attach to multiple records
   411→		}
   412→
   413→		record := JSONLRecord{
   414→			Data: data,
   415→			File: filePath,
   416→			Line: lineNumber,
   417→		}
   418→
   419→		records = append(records, record)
   420→
   421→		// Track last non-summary record for sidechain processing
   422→		if data["uuid"] != nil {
   423→			lastNonSummaryRecord = &record
   424→		}
   425→
   426→		// After processing record, check if we're done
   427→		if atEOF {
   428→			break
   429→		}
   430→	}
   431→
   432→	return records, nil
   433→}
   434→
   435→// eliminateDuplicates removes duplicate records by uuid, keeping the earliest by timestamp
   436→func (p *JSONLParser) eliminateDuplicates(records []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   437→	// Map to track records by uuid
   438→	recordMap := make(map[string]JSONLRecord)
   439→
   440→	for _, record := range records {
   441→		uuid, ok := record.Data["uuid"].(string)
   442→		if !ok || uuid == "" {
   443→			// Skip records without uuid
   444→			continue
   445→		}
   446→
   447→		// If we haven't seen this uuid before, add it
   448→		if existing, exists := recordMap[uuid]; !exists {
   449→			recordMap[uuid] = record
   450→		} else {
   451→			// Compare timestamps and keep the earliest
   452→			existingTS, _ := existing.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   453→			currentTS, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   454→			if currentTS < existingTS {
   455→				slog.Debug("eliminateDuplicates: Duplicate uuid - keeping newer timestamp",
   456→					"uuid", uuid,
   457→					"newTimestamp", currentTS,
   458→					"oldTimestamp", existingTS)
   459→				recordMap[uuid] = record
   460→			} else if currentTS != existingTS {
   461→				slog.Debug("eliminateDuplicates: Duplicate uuid - keeping older timestamp",
   462→					"uuid", uuid,
   463→					"oldTimestamp", existingTS,
   464→					"newTimestamp", currentTS)
   465→			}
   466→		}
   467→	}
   468→
   469→	// Convert map back to slice
   470→	uniqueRecords := make([]JSONLRecord, 0, len(recordMap))
   471→	for _, record := range recordMap {
   472→		uniqueRecords = append(uniqueRecords, record)
   473→	}
   474→
   475→	// Sort by timestamp for deterministic order
   476→	sort.Slice(uniqueRecords, func(i, j int) bool {
   477→		tsI, _ := uniqueRecords[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   478→		tsJ, _ := uniqueRecords[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   479→		return tsI < tsJ
   480→	})
   481→
   482→	return uniqueRecords
   483→}
   484→
   485→// mergeDagsWithSameSessionId merges DAGs that have the same session ID
   486→// This handles cases where Claude Code resumes a session, creating multiple roots for the same session
   487→func (p *JSONLParser) mergeDagsWithSameSessionId(dags [][]JSONLRecord) [][]JSONLRecord {
   488→	// Map to group DAGs by session ID
   489→	sessionDagMap := make(map[string][][]JSONLRecord)
   490→
   491→	for _, dag := range dags {
   492→		if len(dag) == 0 {
   493→			continue
   494→		}
   495→
   496→		// Find the session ID for this DAG
   497→		sessionId := ""
   498→		for _, record := range dag {
   499→			if sid, ok := record.Data["sessionId"].(string); ok && sid != "" {
   500→				sessionId = sid
   501→				break
   502→			}
   503→		}
   504→
   505→		// If no session ID found, treat it as a unique DAG
   506→		if sessionId == "" {
   507→			sessionId = fmt.Sprintf("no-session-%p", &dag)
   508→		}
   509→
   510→		sessionDagMap[sessionId] = append(sessionDagMap[sessionId], dag)
   511→	}
   512→
   513→	// Merge DAGs with the same session ID
   514→	mergedDags := [][]JSONLRecord{}
   515→	for sessionId, dagsForSession := range sessionDagMap {
   516→		if len(dagsForSession) == 1 {
   517→			// No merging needed
   518→			mergedDags = append(mergedDags, dagsForSession[0])
   519→		} else {
   520→			// Merge multiple DAGs for the same session
   521→			slog.Debug("Merging multiple DAGs for session", "sessionId", sessionId, "dagCount", len(dagsForSession))
   522→			mergedDag := []JSONLRecord{}
   523→			for _, dag := range dagsForSession {
   524→				mergedDag = append(mergedDag, dag...)
   525→			}
   526→			mergedDags = append(mergedDags, mergedDag)
   527→		}
   528→	}
   529→
   530→	return mergedDags
   531→}
   532→
   533→// buildDAGs constructs parent/child DAGs from records
   534→func (p *JSONLParser) buildDAGs(records []JSONLRecord) [][]JSONLRecord {
   535→	// Create a map for quick lookup by uuid
   536→	recordByUuid := make(map[string]JSONLRecord)
   537→	for _, record := range records {
   538→		if uuid, ok := record.Data["uuid"].(string); ok {
   539→			recordByUuid[uuid] = record
   540→		}
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Find all root nodes (parentUuid == null)
   544→	roots := []JSONLRecord{}
   545→	for _, record := range records {
   546→		if record.Data["parentUuid"] == nil {
   547→			roots = append(roots, record)
   548→		}
   549→	}
   550→
   551→	// Build a DAG for each root
   552→	dags := [][]JSONLRecord{}
   553→	for _, root := range roots {
   554→		dag := p.buildDAGFromRoot(root, recordByUuid)
   555→		if len(dag) > 0 {
   556→			dags = append(dags, dag)
   557→		}
   558→	}
   559→
   560→	return dags
   561→}
   562→
   563→// buildDAGFromRoot builds a DAG starting from a root node
   564→func (p *JSONLParser) buildDAGFromRoot(root JSONLRecord, recordByUuid map[string]JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   565→	dag := []JSONLRecord{}
   566→	visited := make(map[string]bool)
   567→
   568→	var traverse func(node JSONLRecord)
   569→	traverse = func(node JSONLRecord) {
   570→		uuid, ok := node.Data["uuid"].(string)
   571→		if !ok || visited[uuid] {
   572→			return
   573→		}
   574→
   575→		visited[uuid] = true
   576→		dag = append(dag, node)
   577→
   578→		// Find all children and collect them first
   579→		children := []JSONLRecord{}
   580→		for _, record := range recordByUuid {
   581→			parentUuid, ok := record.Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   582→			if ok && parentUuid == uuid {
   583→				// Check if this child exists in our map (to handle orphans)
   584→				if _, exists := recordByUuid[record.Data["uuid"].(string)]; exists {
   585→					children = append(children, record)
   586→				}
   587→			}
   588→		}
   589→
   590→		// Sort children by timestamp for deterministic traversal order
   591→		sort.Slice(children, func(i, j int) bool {
   592→			tsI, _ := children[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   593→			tsJ, _ := children[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   594→			return tsI < tsJ
   595→		})
   596→
   597→		// Traverse children in sorted order
   598→		for _, child := range children {
   599→			traverse(child)
   600→		}
   601→	}
   602→
   603→	traverse(root)
   604→	return dag
   605→}
   606→
   607→// flattenDAG flattens a DAG into an array ordered by timestamp
   608→func (p *JSONLParser) flattenDAG(dag []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   609→	// Sort by timestamp, with parent-child relationships as tiebreaker
   610→	sort.Slice(dag, func(i, j int) bool {
   611→		tsI, _ := dag[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   612→		tsJ, _ := dag[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   613→		if tsI != tsJ {
   614→			return tsI < tsJ
   615→		}
   616→		// If timestamps are equal, check parent-child relationship
   617→		uuidI, _ := dag[i].Data["uuid"].(string)
   618→		uuidJ, _ := dag[j].Data["uuid"].(string)
   619→		parentI, _ := dag[i].Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   620→		parentJ, _ := dag[j].Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   621→
   622→		// If j is the parent of i, j should come first
   623→		if parentI == uuidJ {
   624→			return false
   625→		}
   626→		// If i is the parent of j, i should come first
   627→		if parentJ == uuidI {
   628→			return true
   629→		}
   630→		// Otherwise, sort by UUID for deterministic ordering
   631→		return uuidI < uuidJ
   632→	})
   633→
   634→	return dag
   635→}
   636→
   637→// FindSession returns a pointer to the session with the given UUID
   638→func (p *JSONLParser) FindSession(sessionUuid string) *Session {
   639→	for i := range p.Sessions {
   640→		if p.Sessions[i].SessionUuid == sessionUuid {
   641→			return &p.Sessions[i]
   642→		}
   643→	}
   644→	return nil
   645→}
   646→
   647→// FindRecord returns a pointer to the first record that matches the given filter function
   648→func (p *JSONLParser) FindRecord(filter func(JSONLRecord) bool) *JSONLRecord {
   649→	for i := range p.Records {
   650→		if filter(p.Records[i]) {
   651→			return &p.Records[i]
   652→		}
   653→	}
   654→	return nil
   655→}
   656→
   657→// FilterRecords returns records that match the given filter function
   658→func (p *JSONLParser) FilterRecords(filter func(JSONLRecord) bool) []JSONLRecord {
   659→	var filtered []JSONLRecord
   660→	for _, record := range p.Records {
   661→		if filter(record) {
   662→			filtered = append(filtered, record)
   663→		}
   664→	}
   665→	return filtered
   666→}
   667→
   668→// Count returns the total number of parsed records
   669→func (p *JSONLParser) Count() int {
   670→	return len(p.Records)
   671→}
   672→

    80→// parseFactorySession converts a Factory Droid JSONL transcript into an fdSession.
    81→func parseFactorySession(filePath string) (*fdSession, error) {
    82→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
    83→	if err != nil {
    84→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("droidcli: unable to open session %s: %w", filePath, err)
    85→	}

    87→		_ = file.Close()

    89→
    90→	session := &fdSession{Blocks: make([]fdBlock, 0, 64)}

    92→	var rawBuilder strings.Builder
    93→	var firstUserText string

    97→		rawBuilder.WriteString(line)

   102→			return nil

   104→
   105→		var env jsonlEnvelope

   107→			// Log warning and skip corrupted lines rather than failing entire parse
   108→			slog.Warn("Skipping corrupted JSONL line",
   109→				"file", filepath.Base(filePath),
   110→				"line", lineNumber,
   111→				"error", err)
   112→			return nil
   113→		}
   114→
   115→		switch env.Type {
   116→		case "session_start":
   117→			var event sessionStartEvent
   118→			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {
   119→				slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed session_start event", "error", err, "file", filePath)
   120→				return nil
   121→			}
   122→			session.ID = fallback(session.ID, firstNonEmpty(event.ID, event.Session.ID))
   123→			session.Title = fallback(session.Title, firstNonEmpty(event.Title, event.Session.Title, event.SessionTitle))
   124→			session.CreatedAt = fallback(session.CreatedAt, firstNonEmpty(event.CreatedAt, event.Session.CreatedAt, event.Timestamp))
   125→			session.WorkspaceRoot = fallback(session.WorkspaceRoot, firstNonEmpty(event.CWD, event.WorkspaceRoot, event.Session.CWD, event.Session.WorkspaceRoot))
   126→		case "message":
   127→			var event messageEvent
   128→			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {
   129→				slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed message event", "error", err, "file", filePath)
   130→				return nil
   131→			}
   132→			if firstTimestamp == "" {
   133→				firstTimestamp = normalizeEventTimestamp(event.Timestamp)
   134→			}
   135→			handleMessageEvent(session, &event, toolIndex)

   139→				}

   141→		case "todo_state":

   143→			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {

   145→				return nil

   150→			if len(event.Todos) == 0 {

   201→func handleMessageEvent(session *fdSession, event *messageEvent, toolIndex map[string]*fdToolCall) {
   202→	role := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Message.Role))
   203→	if role == "" {
   204→		role = "agent"
   205→	}
   206→	model := strings.TrimSpace(event.Message.Model)
   207→
   208→	for _, block := range event.Message.Content {
   209→		switch block.Type {
   210→		case "text":
   211→			appendTextBlock(session, role, model, event.Timestamp, block.Text, false, event.ID)
   212→		case "reasoning", "thinking", "thought":
   213→			// Thinking content may be in the "thinking" field or "text" field depending on the format
   214→			thinkingText := block.Thinking
   215→			if thinkingText == "" {
   216→				thinkingText = block.Text
   217→			}
   218→			appendTextBlock(session, role, model, event.Timestamp, thinkingText, true, event.ID)
   219→		case "tool_use":
   220→			tool := &fdToolCall{
   221→				ID:         block.ID,
   222→				Name:       block.Name,
   223→				Input:      block.Input,
   224→				RiskLevel:  block.RiskLevel,
   225→				RiskReason: block.RiskLevelReason,
   226→				InvokedAt:  event.Timestamp,
   227→			}
   228→			session.Blocks = append(session.Blocks, fdBlock{
   229→				Kind:      blockTool,
   230→				Role:      role,
   231→				MessageID: strings.TrimSpace(event.ID),
   232→				Timestamp: event.Timestamp,
   233→				Model:     model,
   234→				Tool:      tool,
   235→			})
   236→			if tool.ID != "" {
   237→				toolIndex[tool.ID] = tool
   238→			}
   239→		case "tool_result":
   240→			result := &fdToolResult{
   241→				Content: decodeContent(block.Content),
   242→				IsError: block.IsError,
   243→			}
   244→			if ref := toolIndex[block.ToolUseID]; ref != nil {
   245→				ref.Result = result
   246→			} else {
   247→				session.Blocks = append(session.Blocks, fdBlock{
   248→					Kind:      blockTool,
   249→					Role:      role,
   250→					MessageID: strings.TrimSpace(event.ID),
   251→					Timestamp: event.Timestamp,
   252→					Model:     model,
   253→					Tool: &fdToolCall{
   254→						ID:        block.ToolUseID,
   255→						Name:      "tool_result",
   256→						Result:    result,
   257→						InvokedAt: event.Timestamp,
   258→					},
   259→				})
   260→			}
   261→		}
   262→	}
   263→}

   265→func appendTextBlock(session *fdSession, role, model, timestamp, rawText string, reasoning bool, messageID string) {

   270→	session.Blocks = append(session.Blocks, fdBlock{

   281→func firstUserContent(blocks []contentPayload) string {
   282→	for _, block := range blocks {
   283→		if block.Type != "text" {
   284→			continue
   285→		}
   286→		text := strings.TrimSpace(block.Text)
   287→		text = cleanUserText(text)

   291→	}

   295→func decodeContent(raw json.RawMessage) string {
   296→	if len(raw) == 0 || string(raw) == "null" {
   297→		return ""
   298→	}
   299→	var str string
   300→	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &str); err == nil {
   301→		return str
   302→	}
   303→	var arr []map[string]any
   304→	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &arr); err == nil {
   305→		var builder strings.Builder
   306→		for _, item := range arr {
   307→			if text, ok := item["text"].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(text) != "" {
   308→				if builder.Len() > 0 {
   309→					builder.WriteString("\n")
   310→				}
   311→				builder.WriteString(text)
   312→			}
   313→		}
   314→		return builder.String()
   315→	}
   316→	var obj map[string]any
   317→	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &obj); err == nil {
   318→		if text, ok := obj["text"].(string); ok {
   319→			return text
   320→		}
   321→		bytes, err := json.Marshal(obj)
   322→		if err == nil {
   323→			return string(bytes)
   324→		}
   325→	}
   326→	return string(raw)
   327→}

   329→func slugFromContent(text string, title string, created string) string {
   330→	if slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(text); slug != "" {
   331→		return slug
   332→	}
   333→	if slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(title); slug != "" {
   334→		return slug
   335→	}
   336→	if created != "" {
   337→		return strings.ToLower(strings.ReplaceAll(created, ":", "-"))
   338→	}
   339→	return "factory-session"
   340→}

   342→func deriveTimestampFromFilename(path string) string {

   344→	return base

   347→func fallback(current, candidate string) string {

   354→func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {

   367→// Scanner utilities for reading JSONL files
   368→
   369→const (

   372→	maxReasonableLineSize = 250 * mb

   377→func scanLines(reader io.Reader, handle func(lineNumber int, line string) error) error {
   378→	buf := bufio.NewReader(reader)
   379→	lineNumber := 0
   380→
   381→	for {
   382→		line, err := buf.ReadString('\n')
   383→		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
   384→			return err
   385→		}
   386→
   387→		if err == io.EOF && line == "" {
   388→			break
   389→		}
   390→
   391→		lineNumber++
   392→		if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
   393→			return fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB)", lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/mb)
   394→		}
   395→
   396→		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\n")
   397→		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r")
   398→		if line == "" {
   399→			if err == io.EOF {
   400→				break
   401→			}
   402→			continue
   403→		}
   404→
   405→		if handleErr := handle(lineNumber, line); handleErr != nil {
   406→			return handleErr
   407→		}
   408→
   409→		if err == io.EOF {
   410→			break
   411→		}
   412→	}
   413→
   414→	return nil
   415→}
   416→
   417→// Text cleaning utilities
   418→
   419→var systemReminderPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)`)
   420→
   421→func cleanUserText(text string) string {
   422→	clean := systemReminderPattern.ReplaceAllString(text, "")
   423→	return strings.TrimSpace(clean)
   424→}

    12→// GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir returns the path to the Claude Code projects directory
    13→func GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir() (string, error) {
    14→	// Get user's home directory
    15→	homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
    16→	if err != nil {
    17→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get user home directory: %v", err)
    18→	}

    23→	// Check if the directory exists

    25→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
    26→			return "", fmt.Errorf("claude projects directory not found at %s", projectsDir)
    27→		}
    28→		return "", fmt.Errorf("error checking Claude projects directory: %v", err)
    29→	}
    30→
    31→	return projectsDir, nil
    32→}
    33→
    34→// GetClaudeCodeProjectDir returns the Claude Code project directory for the given path.
    35→// If no path is provided (empty string), it uses the current working directory.
    36→// It resolves any symlinks in the path to match Claude Code's behavior, which uses the real path
    37→// when creating project directories. Claude Code requires a specific naming convention to map
    38→// working directories to project folders: each non-alphanumeric character is replaced with a dash
    39→// to create a unique, filesystem-safe identifier
    40→func GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
    41→	// Use provided path or get current working directory
    42→	var cwd string
    43→	var err error
    44→	if projectPath == "" {
    45→		cwd, err = os.Getwd()
    46→		if err != nil {
    47→			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get current working directory: %v", err)
    48→		}
    49→	} else {
    50→		cwd = projectPath
    51→	}
    52→
    53→	// Resolve any symlinks in the path to match Claude Code's behavior
    54→	// Claude Code uses the real path when creating project directories, so
    55→	// if the user's working directory contains symlinks, we need to resolve
    56→	// them to find the correct project directory in ~/.claude/projects/
    57→	realPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cwd)
    58→	if err != nil {
    59→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve symlinks in working directory: %v", err)
    60→	}
    61→
    62→	// Log if the path was changed by symlink resolution
    63→	if realPath != cwd {
    64→		slog.Debug("GetClaudeCodeProjectDir: Resolved symlinks in working directory",
    65→			"original", cwd,
    66→			"resolved", realPath)
    67→	}
    68→
    69→	// Convert path to project directory format using regex
    70→	// Replace anything that's not alphanumeric or dash with a dash (matching Claude Code's behavior)
    71→	// Example: "/Users/sean/My Projects(1)/app" becomes "-Users-sean-My-Projects-1--app"
    72→	reg := regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9-]`)
    73→	projectDirName := reg.ReplaceAllString(realPath, "-")
    74→
    75→	// Add leading dash if not already there
    76→	if !strings.HasPrefix(projectDirName, "-") {
    77→		projectDirName = "-" + projectDirName
    78→	}
    79→
    80→	// Log the transformation for debugging path issues
    81→	slog.Debug("GetClaudeCodeProjectDir: Transformed working directory to project name",
    82→		"cwd", cwd,
    83→		"projectDirName", projectDirName)
    84→
    85→	// Get Claude projects directory
    86→	projectsDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir()
    87→	if err != nil {
    88→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get Claude projects directory: %v", err)
    89→	}
    90→
    91→	fullProjectPath := filepath.Join(projectsDir, projectDirName)
    92→	slog.Debug("GetClaudeCodeProjectDir: Constructed full project path",
    93→		"projectPath", fullProjectPath)
    94→
    95→	return fullProjectPath, nil
    96→}

     1→package droidcli
     2→
     3→import (
     4→	"fmt"
     5→	"io/fs"
     6→	"os"
     7→	"path/filepath"
     8→	"sort"
     9→)
    10→
    11→const (
    12→	factoryRootDir     = ".factory"
    13→	factorySessionsDir = "sessions"
    14→)
    15→
    16→type sessionFile struct {
    17→	Path     string
    18→	ModTime  int64
    19→	FileName string
    20→}
    21→
    22→func resolveSessionsDir() (string, error) {
    23→	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
    24→	if err != nil {
    25→		return "", fmt.Errorf("droidcli: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
    26→	}
    27→	dir := filepath.Join(home, factoryRootDir, factorySessionsDir)
    28→	return dir, nil
    29→}
    30→
    31→func listSessionFiles() ([]sessionFile, error) {
    32→	dir, err := resolveSessionsDir()
    33→	if err != nil {
    34→		return nil, err
    35→	}
    36→	files := make([]sessionFile, 0, 64)
    37→	walker := func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
    38→		if walkErr != nil {
    39→			return nil
    40→		}
    41→		if d.IsDir() {
    42→			return nil
    43→		}
    44→		if filepath.Ext(d.Name()) != ".jsonl" {
    45→			return nil
    46→		}
    47→		info, err := d.Info()
    48→		if err != nil {
    49→			return nil
    50→		}
    51→		files = append(files, sessionFile{
    52→			Path:     path,
    53→			ModTime:  info.ModTime().UnixNano(),
    54→			FileName: d.Name(),
    55→		})
    56→		return nil
    57→	}
    58→	if err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, walker); err != nil {
    59→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
    60→			return []sessionFile{}, nil
    61→		}
    62→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("droidcli: unable to read sessions dir: %w", err)
    63→	}
    64→	sort.Slice(files, func(i, j int) bool {
    65→		return files[i].ModTime > files[j].ModTime
    66→	})
    67→	return files, nil
    68→}
    69→
    70→func findSessionFileByID(sessionID string) (string, error) {
    71→	files, err := listSessionFiles()
    72→	if err != nil {
    73→		return "", err
    74→	}
    75→	for _, file := range files {
    76→		candidate := file.FileName
    77→		if candidate == sessionID || trimExt(candidate) == sessionID {
    78→			return file.Path, nil
    79→		}
    80→	}
    81→	return "", nil
    82→}
    83→
    84→func trimExt(name string) string {
    85→	ext := filepath.Ext(name)
    86→	if ext == "" {
    87→		return name
    88→	}
    89→	return name[:len(name)-len(ext)]
    90→}
    91→

_**Agent - sidechain (claude-opus-4-5-20251101 2026-01-31 15:41:39Z)**_

Now I have a complete picture of the codebase. Let me summarize my findings and propose a design.

## Analysis Summary

### Current Flow

1. **main.go (lines 1409-1413 and 1504-1509)**: Prints "Parsing {Provider} sessions" with no newline, then calls `syncProvider()`
2. **syncProvider() (main.go:1157)**: Calls `provider.GetAgentChatSessions(cwd, debugRaw)` - THIS IS THE SLOW PART
3. After GetAgentChatSessions returns, prints newline and "Syncing markdown files" (main.go:1172)
4. Loop processes sessions with progress dots (main.go:1284-1288)

### How Session Discovery Works

**Claude Code Provider** (`pkg/providers/claudecode/`):
- `GetAgentChatSessions()` calls `parser.ParseProjectSessions()` (jsonl_parser.go)
- Uses `filepath.Walk()` to find all `.jsonl` files in the project directory
- For each file: parses JSON, builds DAGs, deduplicates, flattens
- Already has `NoteProgress()` function that prints dots during parsing (line 117, 139, 144, 164)
- Problem: The caller (`syncProvider`) does not pass down `silent` flag

**Codex CLI Provider** (`pkg/providers/codexcli/`):
- `GetAgentChatSessions()` calls `findCodexSessions()` which traverses `~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/`
- For each session file found, it calls `processSessionToAgentChat()` which reads and parses the full file
- No progress feedback at all

**Droid CLI Provider** (`pkg/providers/droidcli/`):
- `GetAgentChatSessions()` calls `listSessionFiles()` which walks `~/.factory/sessions/`
- For each file, calls `parseFactorySession()` which reads and parses the full file
- No progress feedback at all

### Key Insight: Can We Know Total Files First?

YES! All providers can enumerate files before parsing:
- **Claude Code**: `filepath.Walk()` can count `.jsonl` files first
- **Codex CLI**: The directory traversal already collects all matching sessions
- **Droid CLI**: `listSessionFiles()` already returns all files before parsing

## Design Proposal

### Option 1: Progress Callback in Provider Interface (Recommended)

Add a progress callback parameter to `GetAgentChatSessions`:

```go
// ProgressCallback is called during session parsing to report progress
type ProgressCallback func(current, total int, sessionID string)

// Updated signature
GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress ProgressCallback) ([]AgentChatSession, error)
```

**Pros:**
- Clean, explicit API
- Enables both dot progress and "n/m" count display
- Providers control when to emit progress
- Consistent across all providers

**Cons:**
- Breaking change to Provider interface (requires updating all providers)

### Option 2: Two-Phase Discovery (Alternative)

Add a new method to enumerate sessions without parsing:

```go
// Returns list of session IDs/paths that will be parsed
DiscoverSessions(projectPath string) ([]string, error)

// Parse a single session (already exists as GetAgentChatSession)
```

**Pros:**
- Non-breaking (adds new method)
- Allows counting first, then showing "1/36, 2/36..." progress

**Cons:**
- More complex (two calls needed)
- Some providers may need to re-traverse directory structure
- Adds complexity to caller logic

### Option 3: Minimal Change - Silent Flag Pass-Through

Keep existing interface but ensure `silent` flag is passed through properly. Claude Code already has `NoteProgress()` - just needs the flag passed down.

**Pros:**
- Minimal code change
- Quick to implement

**Cons:**
- Only adds dot progress, not "n/m" counts
- Doesn't address Codex CLI and Droid CLI providers
- Less informative to users

## Recommended Approach: Option 1 with Backward Compatibility

I recommend Option 1 (Progress Callback) with a nil-check for backward compatibility:

```go
// In pkg/spi/provider.go
type ProgressCallback func(current, total int)

// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves all chat sessions for the given project path
// progress: optional callback for progress updates (nil = no progress reporting)
GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress ProgressCallback) ([]AgentChatSession, error)
```

### Implementation Details

**Step 1: Update Provider Interface (pkg/spi/provider.go)**
- Add `ProgressCallback` type
- Update `GetAgentChatSessions` signature

**Step 2: Update Claude Code Provider (pkg/providers/claudecode/)**
- Modify `ParseProjectSessions` to accept and use progress callback
- Count files first (during `filepath.Walk`), then report progress during parsing
- Replace `NoteProgress(silent)` with callback-based progress

**Step 3: Update Codex CLI Provider (pkg/providers/codexcli/)**
- Add file counting before parsing loop
- Report progress after each session is parsed

**Step 4: Update Droid CLI Provider (pkg/providers/droidcli/)**
- Use `len(files)` from `listSessionFiles()` as total
- Report progress after each session is parsed

**Step 5: Update main.go**
- Create progress callback that prints either dots or "n/m" format
- Pass callback to `GetAgentChatSessions()`

### Progress Display Format

```
Parsing Claude Code sessions [5/36]...
Syncing markdown files for Claude Code
..................................

 Claude Code sync complete!  36 sessions processed
```

Or if we prefer dots with a final count:
```
Parsing Claude Code sessions...................................... (36 files)
Syncing markdown files for Claude Code
..................................
```

### Critical Files for Implementation

- `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi/provider.go` - Add ProgressCallback type and update interface signature
- `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/main.go` - Update syncProvider to create and pass progress callback
- `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/claudecode/provider.go` - Implement progress callback in GetAgentChatSessions
- `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/codexcli/provider.go` - Implement progress callback in GetAgentChatSessions
- `/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/droidcli/provider.go` - Implement progress callback in GetAgentChatSessions

    22→	SessionData *schema.SessionData // Structured session data in unified format
    23→	RawData     string              // Raw session data (e.g., JSON blobs for Cursor CLI, JSONL for Claude Code and Codex CLI, etc.)
    24→}
    25→
    26→// Provider defines the interface that all agent coding tool providers must implement
    27→type Provider interface {
    28→	// Name returns the human-readable name of the provider (e.g., "Claude Code", "Cursor CLI", "Codex CLI")
    29→	Name() string
    30→
    31→	// Check verifies if the provider is properly installed and returns version info
    32→	// customCommand: empty string = use detected/default binary path, non-empty = use this specific command/path
    33→	Check(customCommand string) CheckResult
    34→
    35→	// DetectAgent checks if the provider's agent has been used in the given project path
    36→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    37→	// helpOutput: if true AND no activity is found, the provider should output helpful guidance
    38→	// Returns true if the agent has created artifacts/sessions in the specified path
    39→	DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool
    40→
    41→	// GetAgentChatSession retrieves a single chat session by ID for the given project path
    42→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    43→	// sessionID: specific session identifier to retrieve (always provided, never empty)
    44→	// debugRaw: if true, provider should write provider-specific raw debug files to .specstory/debug/<sessionID>/
    45→	//           (e.g., numbered JSON files). The unified session-data.json is written centrally by the CLI.
    46→	// Returns nil if the session is not found, error for actual errors
    47→	GetAgentChatSession(projectPath string, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*AgentChatSession, error)
    48→
    49→	// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves all chat sessions for the given project path
    50→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    51→	// debugRaw: if true, provider should write provider-specific raw debug files to .specstory/debug/<sessionID>/
    52→	//           (e.g., numbered JSON files). The unified session-data.json is written centrally by the CLI.
    53→	// Returns a slice of AgentChatSession structs containing session data
    54→	GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool) ([]AgentChatSession, error)
    55→
    56→	// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the agent in interactive mode and watches for session updates
    57→	// Blocks until the agent exits, calling sessionCallback for each new/updated session
    58→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    59→	// customCommand: empty string = use detected/default binary with default args, non-empty = use this specific command/path
    60→	// resumeSessionID: empty string = start new session, non-empty = resume this specific session ID
    61→	// debugRaw: if true, provider should write provider-specific raw debug files to .specstory/debug/<sessionID>/
    62→	//           (e.g., numbered JSON files). The unified session-data.json is written centrally by the CLI.
    63→	// sessionCallback is called with each session update (provider should not block on callback)
    64→	// The implementation should handle its own file watching and session tracking
    65→	ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*AgentChatSession)) error
    66→
    67→	// WatchAgent watches for agent activity and calls the callback with an updated AgentChatSession
    68→	// Does NOT execute the agent - only watches for new activity
    69→	// Runs until error or context cancellation
    70→	// ctx: Context for cancellation and timeout control
    71→	// projectPath: Agent's working directory
    72→	// debugRaw: if true, provider should write provider-specific raw debug files to .specstory/debug/<sessionID>/
    73→	//           (e.g., numbered JSON files). The unified session-data.json is written centrally by the CLI.
    74→	// sessionCallback: called with AgentChatSession on each update (provider should not block on callback)
    75→	// The implementation should handle its own file watching and session tracking
    76→	WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*AgentChatSession)) error
    77→}

    27→
    28→// filterWarmupMessages removes warmup messages (sidechain messages before first real message)
    29→func filterWarmupMessages(records []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
    30→	// Find first non-sidechain message
    31→	firstRealMessageIndex := -1
    32→	for i, record := range records {
    33→		if isSidechain, ok := record.Data["isSidechain"].(bool); !ok || !isSidechain {
    34→			firstRealMessageIndex = i
    35→			break
    36→		}
    37→	}
    38→
    39→	// No real messages found
    40→	if firstRealMessageIndex == -1 {
    41→		return []JSONLRecord{}
    42→	}
    43→
    44→	// Return records starting from first real message
    45→	return records[firstRealMessageIndex:]
    46→}
    47→
    48→// processSession filters warmup messages and converts a Session to an AgentChatSession
    49→// Returns nil if the session is warmup-only (no real messages)
    50→func processSession(session Session, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
    51→	// Write debug files first (even for warmup-only sessions)
    52→	if debugRaw {
    53→		// Write debug files and get the record-to-file mapping
    54→		_ = writeDebugRawFiles(session) // Unused but needed for side effect
    55→	}
    56→
    57→	// Filter warmup messages
    58→	filteredRecords := filterWarmupMessages(session.Records)
    59→
    60→	// Skip if no real messages remain after filtering warmup
    61→	if len(filteredRecords) == 0 {
    62→		slog.Debug("Skipping warmup-only session", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid)
    63→		return nil
    64→	}
    65→
    66→	// Create session with filtered records
    67→	filteredSession := Session{
    68→		SessionUuid: session.SessionUuid,
    69→		Records:     filteredRecords,
    70→	}
    71→
    72→	// Get timestamp from root record
    73→	rootRecord := filteredSession.Records[0]
    74→	timestamp := rootRecord.Data["timestamp"].(string)
    75→
    76→	// Get the slug
    77→	slug := FileSlugFromRootRecord(filteredSession)
    78→
    79→	// Generate SessionData from filtered session
    80→	sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(filteredSession, workspaceRoot)
    81→	if err != nil {
    82→		slog.Error("Failed to generate SessionData", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid, "error", err)
    83→		return nil
    84→	}
    85→
    86→	// Convert session records to JSONL format for raw data
    87→	// Note: Uses unfiltered session.Records (not filteredSession.Records) to preserve
    88→	// all records including warmup messages in the raw data for complete audit trail
    89→	var rawDataBuilder strings.Builder
    90→	for _, record := range session.Records {
    91→		jsonBytes, _ := json.Marshal(record.Data)
    92→		rawDataBuilder.Write(jsonBytes)
    93→		rawDataBuilder.WriteString("\n")
    94→	}
    95→
    96→	return &spi.AgentChatSession{
    97→		SessionID:   session.SessionUuid,
    98→		CreatedAt:   timestamp, // ISO 8601 timestamp
    99→		Slug:        slug,
   100→		SessionData: sessionData,
   101→		RawData:     rawDataBuilder.String(),
   102→	}

   110→// buildCheckErrorMessage creates a user-facing error message tailored to the failure type.
   111→func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, claudeCmd string, isCustom bool, stderrOutput string) string {
   112→	var errorMsg strings.Builder
   113→
   114→	switch errorType {
   115→	case "not_found":
   116→		errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  🔍 Could not find Claude Code at: %s\n", claudeCmd))
   117→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   118→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n")
   119→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   120→		if isCustom {
   121→			errorMsg.WriteString("     The specified path doesn't exist. Please check:\n")
   122→			errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("     • Is Claude Code installed at %s?\n", claudeCmd))
   123→			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Did you type the path correctly?")
   124→		} else {
   125→			errorMsg.WriteString("     1. Make sure Claude Code is installed:\n")
   126→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Visit https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart\n")
   127→			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   128→			errorMsg.WriteString("     2. If it's already installed, try:\n")
   129→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Check if 'claude' is in your PATH\n")
   130→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Use -c flag to specify the full path\n")
   131→			errorMsg.WriteString("        • Example: specstory check claude -c \"~/.claude/local/claude\"")
   132→		}
   133→	case "permission_denied":
   134→		errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  🔒 Permission denied when trying to run: %s\n", claudeCmd))
   135→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   136→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n")
   137→		errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("     • Check file permissions: chmod +x %s\n", claudeCmd))
   138→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running with elevated permissions if needed")
   139→	case "unexpected_output":
   140→		errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  ⚠️  Unexpected output from 'claude -v': %s\n", strings.TrimSpace(stderrOutput)))
   141→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   142→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 This might not be Claude Code. Expected output containing '(Claude Code)'.\n")
   143→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure you have Claude Code installed, not a different 'claude' command\n")
   144→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Visit https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart for installation")
   145→	default:
   146→		errorMsg.WriteString("  ⚠️  Error running 'claude -v'\n")
   147→		if stderrOutput != "" {
   148→			errorMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  📋 Error details: %s\n", stderrOutput))
   149→		}
   150→		errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
   151→		errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Troubleshooting tips:\n")
   152→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure Claude Code is properly installed\n")
   153→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running 'claude -v' directly in your terminal\n")
   154→		errorMsg.WriteString("     • Check https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart for installation help")
   155→	}
   156→
   157→	return errorMsg.String()
   158→}
